title: Easy On-Call Phone Assistant, US Non-Emergency Medical Transport (Very Light Call Volume, Flat Monthly Pay)
description:
About us

We're a non-emergency medical transport company in the southeastern US. We drive people to medical appointments and facility visits. Our US dispatcher covers the daytime, and we're looking for one friendly, dependable person to cover our phone line after hours.



How the job works

This is one of the easiest on-call jobs you'll find. Call volume is very light, usually just a handful of short calls a shift, and the rest of the time is yours. Run errands, spend time with family, or study, as long as your phone is with you.



This is an on-call job, not a desk job. Our calls forward to a phone app on your device, so you can go about your day as long as you can answer promptly. Most shifts are very quiet. When a call comes in, we need you to answer kindly, sort it out, and write it down.



Your on-call hours

Monday to Friday, 5:00 PM to 8:00 AM US Eastern Time (6:00 AM to 9:00 PM Manila time), plus every other Saturday and Sunday.



What you'll do

- Answer calls from our partner facilities, riders, and drivers

- Reschedule or cancel rides in our dispatch software, following our written steps

- Do light scheduling when needed

- When a driver calls out, call our other drivers to find coverage

- Leave clear notes so our morning dispatcher knows what happened overnight

- Know when to call a US manager (we'll give you a simple list)



What you need

- Clear, friendly spoken English and good phone manners

- Reliable internet

- A quiet place to take calls, and a smartphone or computer that can run our phone app

- Experience with US healthcare, medical transport, or customer service calls is a strong plus

- HIPAA training, or willingness to complete it before you start

- An NBI clearance

- Willingness to sign a confidentiality agreement and a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement. You'll be handling private health information, so privacy matters a lot to us.

- Calm, caring, and dependable. Missing calls is the one thing this job can't have.



What we offer

- $400 USD a month, flat, paid on time, every month

- Steady, long-term work with a small, kind US team

- Full training and simple written steps, so you're never guessing

- A raise to look at after 90 days

- Work from home with no commute and no sitting at a desk



How to apply

1. Send a short message about yourself and your phone or customer service experience.

2. Include a link (Google Drive, unlisted YouTube, or Loom) to a 1 to 2 minute video of yourself acting out this call. A caller from a care facility says: "Hi, our resident has a ride tomorrow at 9 AM, but the appointment moved to 1 PM. Can you change it?" Answer as if you work for us. Please make up all names and details.

3. Start your message with the words "Night Line" so we know you read the whole post.



Thank you for your interest. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Lead Shopify Developer & Marketing Manager
description:
Company: 5Star Wireless Accessories & More LLC  

Brands: 5Star Wireless & Genie ISP  

Position Type: Full-time — 40 hours per week  

Reports To: Founder/CEO



About the Role



We’re seeking a Lead Shopify Developer & Marketing Manager to lead ecommerce development, digital marketing, and business automation across our two brands: 5Star Wireless and Genie ISP.



This is a hands-on leadership position for someone who can build, create, manage, and deliver. You should be comfortable developing custom Shopify functionality, producing compelling marketing content, connecting platforms through APIs, and turning business ideas into dependable systems.



You will oversee an Ecommerce Coordinator responsible for daily store maintenance, product listings, page updates, and other ecommerce assignments. Your responsibility is to establish priorities, provide direction, review completed work, and handle advanced technical development and marketing initiatives.



Marketing is an ongoing responsibility of this position. During major development projects, your focus may shift toward coding and implementation. Between those projects, your primary focus will be marketing campaigns, short-form video production, customer acquisition, store performance, and developing useful business systems.



We need someone who takes ownership, thinks independently, communicates clearly, and follows through without constant supervision.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires a consistent commitment of 40 hours per week, with an agreed working schedule and availability for team meetings, collaboration, and timely communication.



Working hours must be dedicated to assigned company responsibilities. Other professional commitments must not interfere with your agreed schedule, availability, performance, or deadlines.



You are expected to communicate promptly when blocked, request direction when priorities are unclear, and identify useful next steps when assignments are completed.



Key Responsibilities



Shopify Development & Store Optimization



- Lead technical development and improvements across both Shopify stores.

- Develop and customize Shopify themes using Liquid, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Shopify theme architecture.

- Build reusable sections, templates, and features that support merchandising and marketing campaigns.

- Improve mobile usability, navigation, product discovery, page performance, and the overall shopping experience.

- Review website changes completed by the Ecommerce Coordinator and make technical, visual, and functional refinements.

- Diagnose and resolve theme issues, app conflicts, broken functionality, and integration problems.

- Evaluate existing apps and recommend when to configure an available solution versus developing something custom.

- Implement improvements that help customers understand our products, complete purchases, and access support.

- Test changes before release and maintain a practical rollback process.



Custom Apps, APIs & Business Systems



- Develop and maintain custom Shopify apps, internal tools, and integrations.

- Work with Shopify APIs, GraphQL, webhooks, authentication, and third-party services.

- Build workflows that connect ecommerce, customer records, communications, and other business platforms.

- Help develop a lease-to-own platform, including customer-facing pages, application workflows, customer portals, and supporting integrations.

- Translate business requirements into clear technical plans, milestones, and working solutions.

- Develop backend services and databases where needed.

- Maintain existing systems, troubleshoot failures, and improve reliability over time.



AI & Customer Follow-Up Automation



- Build and improve automated customer follow-up workflows.

- Develop or integrate AI calling agents for approved uses such as inquiries, appointment reminders, lead follow-up, and customer service.

- Connect calling and messaging systems with relevant customer records and business tools.

- Include appropriate consent handling, opt-out controls, human handoffs, and activity records.

- Identify repetitive work that can be simplified through automation.

- Evaluate AI tools based on their practical usefulness, reliability, and cost.

- Document workflows so other team members can operate and maintain them.



Digital Marketing & Campaign Execution



- Plan and execute marketing initiatives for both brands.

- Develop campaigns around products, services, promotions, and customer needs.

- Create landing pages and supporting customer journeys.

- Coordinate
, SMS, social media, and paid advertising initiatives as appropriate.

- Develop campaign messaging, offers, calls to action, and creative concepts.

- Monitor campaign performance and recommend improvements based on results.

- Test different messages, creative assets, and page experiences.

- Keep marketing activity moving consistently between technical projects.



Short-Form Video & Creative Content



- Personally create and edit engaging short-form videos for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts.

- Develop strong hooks, scripts, captions, product demonstrations, and promotional concepts.

- Use sound judgment about pacing, visual presentation, branding, and audience relevance.

- Produce content with a clear purpose and call to action.

- Use AI-assisted creative tools where they improve quality or efficiency.

- Maintain accuracy in product claims, pricing, offers, and service descriptions.

- Coordinate supporting content assignments with the Ecommerce Coordinator.



Ecommerce Leadership & Accountability



- Oversee the Ecommerce Coordinator’s assignments and priorities.

- Set clear expectations, deadlines, and acceptance criteria.

- Review work for accuracy, functionality, presentation, and alignment with business goals.

- Provide constructive feedback and ensure necessary corrections are completed.

- Maintain a clear project backlog covering both stores, marketing initiatives, and development work.

- Communicate progress, blockers, risks, and recommendations to ownership.

- Raise questions early when requirements are unclear.

- Take responsibility for completing projects and verifying that finished work functions as intended.



Required Qualifications



Shopify & Development Experience



- Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining Shopify stores beyond basic theme-editor changes.

- Strong working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Experience working with Shopify themes, sections, templates, metafields, and app integrations.

- Experience developing custom Shopify apps and API integrations.

- Familiarity with GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, and secure authentication.

- Full-stack development experience, including a backend language or framework such as Node.js, Python, or an equivalent.

- Experience with databases, application hosting, deployment, and troubleshooting.

- Experience using Git or another version-control system.

- Ability to test changes, investigate errors, and maintain working production systems.



Marketing & Creative Experience



- Demonstrated experience planning and executing digital marketing campaigns.

- A portfolio of short-form marketing videos you personally created or edited.

- Strong written communication and customer-facing copywriting skills.

- An eye for design, layout, branding, and customer experience.

- Ability to interpret marketing and ecommerce performance data and turn findings into practical actions.



Leadership & Work Habits



- Experience coordinating projects or directing another team member’s work.

- Strong organization, prioritization, and follow-through.

- Ability to work independently while keeping management informed.

- Confidence to recommend a better approach and explain your reasoning respectfully.

- Willingness to accept feedback and take responsibility for mistakes.

- Careful handling of customer information, credentials, and company assets.

- Ability to provide realistic estimates and communicate promptly when a deadline is at risk.

- Availability to consistently fulfill the 40-hour weekly commitment.



Preferred Experience



- TypeScript and React.

- Shopify Functions, customer account extensions, or other Shopify extensions.

- AI voice agents, telephony integrations, and CRM automation.

- Automation tools such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.

-
 and SMS marketing platforms such as Klaviyo.

- Paid social advertising and creative testing.

- SEO, analytics, conversion tracking, and conversion optimization.

- Customer portals, subscription platforms, or lease-to-own systems.

- Mobile application development using React Native, Flutter, or similar technologies.

- Experience supporting multiple brands or stores.



What Success Looks Like



- Both Shopify stores are dependable, easy to use, and consistently improving.

- Ecommerce assignments have clear owners, deadlines, and quality standards.

- Technical projects move from planning to tested implementation.

- Marketing campaigns and short-form content are produced consistently.

- Performance reporting connects activity to meaningful outcomes, such as qualified leads, purchases, conversion, and customer engagement.

- Automations reduce manual work and include a clear process for handling errors.

- Code, documentation, and system access remain accessible to the company.

- Ownership receives timely updates without needing to repeatedly request progress.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your résumé and a brief introduction explaining why you fit this combined development, marketing, and leadership role.

2. Shopify examples, describing the code or functionality you personally developed.

3. A custom app, API integration, or automation example, explaining the business problem and your contribution.

4. Two or three short-form marketing videos you personally created or edited.

5. A marketing campaign example, including your responsibilities and results where available.

6. Your availability, preferred working schedule, other ongoing commitments, and compensation expectations.



If previous work is confidential, you may provide a redacted case study, demonstration, or walkthrough instead of sharing private code or customer information.



Please distinguish work you personally completed from work completed by a team.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to participate in a technical discussion, portfolio walkthrough, and a paid practical assessment.



We’re looking for someone who can take an idea, develop a practical plan, build the solution, and help market it successfully.

title: SHOPIFY WEBSITE DESIGNER & AI DIGITAL MARKETING SPECIALIST
description:
FULL-TIME POSITION – PHILIPPINES



Salary: Starting from PHP 20,000 per month – higher salary available based on experience and proven skills.



Working Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time (40 hours per week)



Experience: Minimum 2 years



APPLY DIRECTLY VIA WHATSAPP: 
Start your WhatsApp message with: "YES, I CAN SHOW MY WORK!"



😄 BEFORE YOU APPLY – PLEASE READ!



We've interviewed some AMAZING résumés lately!



Apparently, everyone is a Shopify expert, Photoshop professional, advertising genius and AI specialist!



Some applicants have so many skills and qualifications that we're surprised they haven't listed themselves on the stock exchange yet! 😂



But then we get on Zoom...



Suddenly nobody can show us a Shopify backend, Photoshop won't open, Canva projects have disappeared, and apparently ChatGPT, Grok, Zeely and every other AI platform have forgotten all the incredible work they've supposedly created!



We've even had applicants tell us they've built websites, created hundreds of advertisements and mastered every AI tool available, but when we ask them to open their accounts and show us their projects... there's nothing there! 😂



And our personal favourite?



Applicants agree to screen sharing, join the interview, and then suddenly tell us "Sorry, I can't share my screen because of privacy!"



Privacy? We're asking to see your work, not your bank account! 😂



We respect personal privacy and confidential client information. We only need to see relevant work, authorised projects or a live demonstration of your skills.



We're not looking for the world's best résumé. We're looking for someone who can actually do the work!



If you've built Shopify websites, show us what you've built and demonstrate the backend.



If you've created advertising campaigns, show us the actual campaigns.



If you've used Canva, ChatGPT, Grok, Zeely or other AI tools, show us the projects and work you've created.



If you're experienced in Photoshop, open the program and show us what you can do with layers.

, Instagram, TikTok and Google.

WORKING HOURS & SCREEN SHARING

Alba Talent helps US businesses generate sales opportunities through outbound campaigns. We're hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a portfolio of around 30 client accounts and build the processes that help us serve more clients well.



You should have already owned client relationships inside an established lead-generation, appointment-setting or outsourced-sales agency. We want someone who can explain what worked at a larger agency, what they personally improved, and how they would adapt it here.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Lead onboarding, client reviews and regular proactive communication.

- Explain campaign performance clearly and agree practical next steps with clients.

- Track client health, churn and net revenue retention, with clear records and recovery plans.

- Identify relevant upsells when they will help the client and delivery capacity supports them.

- Build repeatable onboarding, reporting and escalation processes as the agency grows.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Detailed, hands-on experience managing paying clients in a lead-generation, appointment-setting or outsourced-sales agency. You must understand cold
, cold calling and LinkedIn outreach, and how these services generate opportunities for clients.

- Proven experience selling to American business owners and upselling existing clients into additional lead-generation services or campaigns. Be ready to explain what you sold, why it suited the client, your role in closing it and the additional revenue generated.

- Evidence of retaining clients, growing accounts and improving how an agency operates.

- Excellent spoken and written English: you can build rapport with US business owners, explain disappointing results honestly and lead a confident video call.

- Initiative and follow-through: you notice problems, take action, keep people updated and close the loop without constant reminders.

- Commercial judgment, empathy and a genuine interest in helping clients succeed.

- Reliable internet, a quiet workspace and willingness to work US Eastern Time business hours, including the seasonal change between EST and EDT. Confirm the hours you can consistently cover.



COMPENSATION

- USD $2,000 monthly base.

- USD $500 monthly performance bonus when the agreed net revenue retention target is achieved. The initial target is at least 95% monthly NRR for the first three measured months, followed by a review.

- 10% of additional recurring subscription payments from qualifying upsells you originate, for the first three paid service months of each upsell. This applies to the increase, not the client's entire subscription.



Example: an upgrade adds $1,000 per month. Your commission is $100 for each of its first three paid months, or $300 total.



Full measurement, attribution and payment terms will be provided before an agreement. Exact working hours within the US Eastern Time schedule and engagement terms will be agreed during hiring.



TO APPLY - COMPLETE BOTH STEPS

title: Account Executive – Sports Uniforms & Athletic Gear (Remote)
description:
About Us



Phoenix Performance Solutions is a fast-growing U.S.-based sports company focused on custom uniforms, athletic gear, leagues, and performance products. We work with youth and adult sports organizations across the United States and are actively expanding our football, cheer, basketball, baseball, and softball divisions.



We are looking for a highly motivated remote Account Executive to help grow our custom sports uniform and gear business by building relationships with teams, leagues, coaches, athletic directors, and organizations.



This is a long-term opportunity for the right person.



---



## Compensation



Hourly Pay: $5–$12 USD/hour depending on experience and communication skills

Commission with each close. Higher commission with lower hourly rate. Structure



 * Sliding scale commissions based on profitability and deal structure

 * Higher-margin deals = higher commission opportunities

 * Strong performers may grow into leadership opportunities



---



## What You’ll Do



* Prospect and identify new leads across youth and adult sports organizations

* Reach out through:



 * Cold calling

 * Email outreach

 *
/social media outreach

 * Text messaging

 * Follow-up campaigns

* Build long-term relationships with coaches, leagues, and organizations

* Educate potential clients about our uniforms, apparel, and athletic gear

* Manage the relationship from initial contact through payment

* Pass completed order details to management/operations for mockups and production

* Ensure all client information and updates are logged accurately into Zoho CRM

* Follow up consistently with clients throughout the sales process

* Help generate repeat business and referrals



---



## What We Provide



* Sales guidance and onboarding

* Product education and pricing structure

* Marketing materials and resources

* Lead lists and outreach support

* Ongoing coaching and support

* AI/LLM tools and workflow recommendations

* Assistance on larger calls when needed

* Unlimited commission potential!



You will NOT be expected to figure everything out on your own. We want someone willing to learn, improve, and grow with the company.



---



## Requirements



### MUST HAVE:



* Strong spoken and written English

* Minimal accent and excellent communication skills

* Reliable internet connection

* Comfortable making outbound calls

* Comfortable with CRM usage and organization

* Ability to work during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

* Strong professionalism and ethical communication



### PREFERRED:



* Cold calling or sales experience

* Sports knowledge (football, cheer, basketball, baseball, softball)

* Experience using Zoho CRM or similar systems

* Familiarity with AI tools or LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)

* Experience managing customer relationships long-term



---



## Important Notes



We are looking for relationship builders, not aggressive short-term salespeople.



We value professionalism, honesty, and long-term partnerships with our customers. Calls may occasionally be joined by management or recorded/shared internally for quality assurance, training, and maintaining ethical sales standards.



If you are someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers, building trust, and growing relationships, we would love to speak with you.



---



## To Apply



Please include:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your sales experience

3. Experience with cold calling

4. Your experience working with U.S.-based clients

5. A voice recording introducing yourself

6. What sports you are familiar with

7. Your availability in U.S. Central Time

8. Why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role



Bonus points if you have experience in sports apparel, uniforms, or athletic organizations.

title: PR Manager
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and proactive Public Relations (PR) Manager to lead our firm’s reputation and visibility through earned media.  This role is essential in strengthening our reputation, securing media opportunities, and supporting our attorneys and leadership team with interviews, speaking engagements, and public-facing initiatives. Experience in legal or professional services PR, or a background in journalism, is strongly preferred.

Key Responsibilities:

Media Relations and Earned Coverage

Build and maintain a targeted media list covering business, immigration, investment, and international outlets, including markets such as US, Europe, Canada, and Asia

Pitch Ashoori Law and Michael Ashoori as sources and commentators; responds to reporter requests

Identify and secure opportunities for podcasts, webinars, interviews, and speaking engagements

Serve as the primary contact or media inquiries and manage interview logistics

Thought leadership

Secure podcasts, webinars, panels, interviews, and speaking engagements

Write and edit bylined articles and op-eds that build Ashoori Law’s authority

Prepare talking points, briefing documents, media prep and professional bios

Reputation and Authority

Grow Ashoori Law’s public profile and search presence as a firm (brand mentions, Google Knowledge Panel, Google Business Profile, legal and business listings), working with the SEO Specialist.

Identify and submit to relevant legal directories, rankings and awards.

Maintain a crisis and reputation response plan and coordinate responses to negative press or public complaints with leadership.

Share every earned mention and link with the SEO Specialist so coverage supports organic search.

Press Releases

Draft and distribute press releases for milestones, new services, events and announcements.

Maintain a press kit: firm overview, approved bios, headshots and approved facts.

Conferences and Events

Research and recommend industry conferences, investor events and speaking opportunities, in coordination with the Business Development Director.

Handle logistics: registrations, booth materials, schedules and coordination.

Work with our designer to create handouts, brochures and branded event materials.

Client Stories and Testimonials

Collect written and video testimonials and client success stories for Ashoori Law and USA Immigration Lawyer (USAIL), with written client consent on file.

Hand approved stories to the Organic Content Manager for editing and publishing.

Compliance

Send every public statement (quotes, releases, bylines, bios, testimonials) through attorney review before it goes out.

Follow attorney advertising rules and our internal standards.

Reporting

Track placements, outlet tier, reach, backlinks, referral traffic and leads attributed to PR.

Send a monthly PR report to the Marketing Manager with results and next month's plan.





Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Public Relations, Journalism, Communications, Marketing, or a related field

3–5 years of PR or media relations, or in journalism with PR experience

PR experience at a law firm (ideally immigration) or in another highly regulated industry, such as financial services, healthcare or insurance

A background in journalism or newsroom is a strong plus

A portfolio of 3-5 earned placements you personally secured (with links), plus one press release, and one byline or op-ed you wrote

Strong writing, editing, and pitching skills

Excellent organizational and project management abilities

Comfortable working directly with attorneys, executives, and journalists

Familiarity with PR tools, press release platforms, and analytics/reporting

Knowledge of legal industry marketing standards is a plus

What We Offer:

Competitive salary + performance bonuses

Supportive and mission-driven team culture

Professional growth and development opportunities

Access to events, conferences, and networking platforms







Job Type: Full-time

title: H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal
description:
# H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal (Remote | Contract)



### About the Role



**USImmigration.ai** is looking for an experienced **H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal** based in the Philippines to support the development, testing, and improvement of our immigration case management platform.



USImmigration.ai is an AI-powered intake, retainer, and case management platform designed for U.S. immigration law firms. We are expanding our capabilities to support H-1B (including LCA) and EB-2/EB-3 PERM cases.



We are seeking a highly skilled immigration paralegal with extensive hands-on experience managing H-1B and PERM cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate understands U.S. employment-based immigration processes, documentation requirements, compliance workflows, and case management systems.



In addition to applying your paralegal expertise, you will help ensure that our platform accurately reflects real-world immigration case preparation and workflows.



Your knowledge and feedback will directly contribute to building a more efficient and reliable platform for immigration professionals.



### Key Responsibilities



**H-1B and PERM Case Management Expertise**



- Apply extensive knowledge of H-1B and PERM case preparation, documentation, and filing procedures.

- Review H-1B case requirements, including LCA preparation, Form I-129, H Classification Supplement, supporting documentation, amendments, transfers, extensions, and RFE responses.

- Review PERM processes, including prevailing wage determinations, recruitment requirements, ETA-9089 preparation, audit documentation, and filing deadlines.

- Ensure case workflows and documentation requirements align with established immigration paralegal practices.

- Identify missing, inaccurate, or inconsistent information in immigration forms, questionnaires, support letters, and case documents.



**Platform Testing and Workflow Improvement**



- Test H-1B and PERM functionalities using fictional or synthetic immigration cases.

- Evaluate the accuracy and completeness of forms, documents, questionnaires, checklists, and case workflows generated by the platform.

- Identify system errors, missing features, and opportunities to improve the platform's functionality.

- Provide recommendations for case management workflows, required fields, document checklists, deadline tracking, and case status updates.

- Compare platform features with established immigration case management systems and recommend improvements.

- Work closely with developers to explain how H-1B and PERM processes should function from a paralegal's perspective.

- Document testing findings and provide clear, actionable feedback.

- Re-test updated features to ensure issues have been properly resolved.



**Team Collaboration**



- Participate in regular meetings with the founders, developers, and other team members.

- Collaborate with existing testers to maintain consistency across immigration case workflows.

- Assist in developing and improving standardized immigration case procedures and documentation requirements.

- Provide practical recommendations based on real-world experience working in U.S. immigration law firms.



### Qualifications



**Required**



- At least **5 years of hands-on experience as a U.S. Immigration Paralegal**, with extensive experience handling H-1B and PERM cases.

- Strong knowledge of H-1B petitions, LCA preparation and certification, public access files, amendments, extensions, transfers, and RFE responses.

- Extensive experience with PERM labor certification, prevailing wage determinations, recruitment procedures, ETA-9089 preparation, and audit documentation.

- At least 3 years of experience using immigration case management software such as INSZoom, LawLogix Guardian, Docketwise, Cerenade eIMMIGRATION, or similar platforms preferred.

- Strong understanding of U.S. employment-based immigration processes and documentation requirements.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to identify errors or missing information in immigration forms and documents.

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and provide clear feedback.

- Must be based in the **Philippines** and available to work with at least **4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific Time**.



**Preferred Qualifications**



- Experience handling other employment-based immigration categories, including EB-1, EB-2 NIW, L-1, O-1, TN, and E-2.

- Familiarity with DOL FLAG, USCIS online filing systems, and immigration compliance requirements.

- Experience configuring or managing immigration case management platforms.

- Previous involvement in software testing, quality assurance, or workflow improvement.

- Familiarity with Jira, Trello, Notion, Loom, Figma, or similar collaboration tools.



### Confidentiality and Data Protection



The selected candidate will be required to sign a confidentiality agreement.



All platform testing must use fictional or synthetic case files, company-provided data, or publicly available materials. Real client documents or information from current or previous employers, including redacted materials, are strictly prohibited.



All compliance-sensitive requirements and final legal interpretations will be reviewed and approved by qualified U.S. immigration counsel.



### Work Arrangement



- **Position:** H-1B & PERM Immigration Paralegal

- **Employment Type:** Independent Contractor

- **Location:** Remote – Philippines

- **Schedule:** Flexible, with at least 4 hours of overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

- **Equipment:** Reliable computer, stable internet connection, and a quiet environment for video meetings



### About the Company



USImmigration.ai Inc. is a California corporation based in Woodland Hills, California. We develop innovative immigration technology solutions designed to streamline case management, client intake, documentation, and workflows for U.S. immigration law firms.



### How to Apply



If you have extensive H-1B and PERM immigration paralegal experience and are interested in contributing your expertise to an innovative immigration technology platform, we encourage you to apply!



**Please complete our application form:**

title: Evening Shift Guest Support VA | Dubai Holiday Homes | 8PM to 12AM Dubai Time
description:
Stayfinity manages holiday homes in Dubai. We are looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant for our evening guest support shift and for full replacement shifts when a team member is off.



SCHEDULE

Regular shift: 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM Dubai time (12:00 AM to 4:00 AM Philippine time), about 4 hours per night.

The times can be adjusted to a certain extent, so please tell us what you can offer.

We also need someone who is happy to take over a complete shift (a full day or evening) when a local team member is off, and who can help in busy periods. Extra hours are paid and announced in advance. Working hours are tracked, and shifts are checked regularly.



PAY

USD 4 per hour, negotiable depending on experience and availability.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer guest messages on booking platforms and WhatsApp, and take phone calls

- Help guests with check-in, access and urgent issues during their stay

- Coordinate with cleaning and maintenance teams

- Escalate emergencies immediately according to our rules

- Write a clear handover report at the end of every shift



OUR STANDARD

We expect a 5-star guest experience, every time. Guests in Dubai are used to high service levels, so copy-paste answers do not work for us. Every reply should sound personal, warm and written for this specific guest and situation. You may use tools to help you draft, but you are responsible for every message you send, and it must read like a real person who cares.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Fluent English, written and spoken, comfortable on phone calls

- Strong multitasking: several chats and a call at the same time without dropping anything

- Calm under pressure, honest, self-managed, and someone who finishes what they start

- Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality or customer support

- Quiet workspace, reliable computer, headset, webcam, stable internet with a backup connection and backup power



NOT FOR YOU IF

- You want to log in, answer a few messages and log out

- You need someone to check on you to stay focused

- You cannot reliably work the evening hours in Dubai time



HOW TO APPLY

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph only. Start your message with STAYFINITY EVENING so we know you read everything. Applications without this word or with missing answers will not be reviewed.



Include the following in your message:

1. Your resume

2. Your experience with short-term rentals, hospitality or customer support, and the tools and software you have used

3. Your computer setup: laptop or desktop, headset, webcam, and your internet speed (screenshot of a speed test)

4. Your backup plan if your internet or power fails during a shift

5. Which days and hours you can work, and whether you can cover full replacement shifts

6. Do you have another job or commitments during these hours?

7. A guest writes at 11:40 PM: the door code does not work, they just landed after a long flight and are outside with two children. Write your reply to the guest and list what you do behind the scenes in the next 10 minutes.

8. While you handle question 7, a second guest asks for a late check-out and a third reports no hot water. In what order do you handle the three and why?

title: Real Estate Acquisitions Manager | Full-Time + Bonuses
description:
Big Bear Homebuyers is hiring a Real Estate Acquisitions Manager who can help us turn leads into signed contracts.



This is not a generic VA role and it is not just a cold-calling position. The role will be a mix of outbound prospecting and handling inbound seller leads, so you must be comfortable starting conversations as well as responding quickly to homeowners who contact us. You must have previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience and understand how a deal moves from the first seller conversation to a signed purchase agreement.



THE ROLE



You will be expected to take leads through the full acquisitions process:



Inbound or outbound lead → qualify seller → comp property → negotiate → make offer → follow up → signed contract



WHAT YOU’LL DO



• Make high-volume outbound calls to motivated leads who raised their hand about selling their home

• Respond promptly to inbound calls, texts, and leads from motivated sellers

• Work both inbound and outbound opportunities through the full acquisitions process

• Speak directly with motivated sellers and build real rapport

• Qualify motivation, timeline, property condition, and asking price

• Comp properties using recent comparable sales

• Determine ARV and estimate repairs

• Understand investor pricing and calculate an appropriate offer

• Negotiate price with homeowners

• Make offers and follow up consistently by phone and SMS

• Send purchase agreements and guide sellers through signing

• Keep every lead and conversation organized in our CRM

• Hit clear activity, follow-up, offer, and signed-contract targets



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



• Previous U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience is required

• You have personally comped properties and know how to determine ARV

• You understand repairs, investor pricing, and how to calculate a realistic offer

• You have personally spoken with motivated sellers and negotiated price

• You have experience following up with leads until they make a decision

• You know how to send a purchase agreement and get it signed

• Strong spoken and written English

• You sound natural, confident, and conversational on the phone — no robotic or cheesy sales scripts

• You are reliable, organized, coachable, and accountable



You must be comfortable handling both inbound and outbound seller conversations. High-volume outbound calling experience is strongly preferred. GoHighLevel experience is a plus.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE



You are comfortable owning a lead instead of simply passing it along. You ask smart questions, think through the numbers, handle objections, make reasonable offers, and keep following up. You care about results and want to help get properties under contract.



If your background is only general virtual assistant work and you have not worked in U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions, this role is not a fit.



COMPENSATION



• $1200 USD per month base salary

• Uncapped performance bonuses

• Opportunities to earn bonuses based on qualified opportunities and signed or closed deals

• Compensation and responsibility can increase as you prove your results



Strong performers can earn significantly more than the base salary. This is intended to become a stable, long-term role for the right person.



SCHEDULE



This is a full-time position working primarily during U.S. Eastern Time business hours.



YOU MUST HAVE



• Reliable high-speed internet

• A quiet, professional workspace

• A quality headset

• A backup internet and power solution strongly preferred



HOW TO APPLY



Please answer every question below. Generic applications or applications without the requested voice recording will not be considered.



1. How many years of U.S. real estate wholesaling or acquisitions experience do you have?

2. Have you personally comped properties before? Explain how you determine ARV.

3. Tell me about a recent property you helped get under contract. What was the ARV, seller asking price, offer price, and final contract price?

4. Have you personally negotiated price with homeowners?

5. Have you ever sent a purchase agreement and gotten it signed by a seller?

6. What CRM and real estate tools have you used?

7. Please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your real estate acquisitions experience.



Please also include your resume and expected monthly salary in USD.



We are looking for someone who can help us get properties under contract — not someone who only wants to make calls.

Interconnection is one of the final critical steps in bringing a solar system online. As an Interconnection Specialist, you'll help navigate utility requirements, solve project challenges, and keep customers informed while ensuring projects move efficiently toward activation.

If you're organized, technically minded, and have strong communication and problem-solving skills, we'd love to hear from you.

title: MSP Automation Developer
description:
COMPANY



Parachute Technology is a Managed IT Service Provider. We have a friendly and supportive work environment, with a hands-on leadership. Primary headquarters is in San Ramon, CA.





We are doubling down on automation to improve client experience, reduce ticket volume, and increase technician throughput. You will design, build, and maintain automations across our PSA, RMM, and cloud platforms to streamline workflows, accelerate ticket resolution, and keep client environments compliant and well-configured at scale.





Job Description



Automation and scripting

Build and maintain reusable automations in Immybot, PowerShell/Python for Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure/Intune, and common MSP tooling.

Create event-driven workflows using APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS/RPA (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate, Zapier, Logic Apps).

Implement self-healing tasks in RMM for alert remediation, patching, software deployment, and configuration drift correction.



Workflow Optimization



Map current service workflows (incident, request, change, onboarding/offboarding) and eliminate waste via automation.

Reduce technician touch time by building triage, enrichment, and classification automations in the PSA.

Automate asset lifecycle tasks: discovery, tagging, baseline config, policy enforcement, and documentation updates.

Platform Engineering and Reliability



Own configuration hygiene across tenants (baseline policies, hardening, Intune device compliance, Conditional Access).

Create CI/CD pipelines for scripts and policy-as-code with version control, peer review, and rollback.

Add observability: logging, metrics, alerting, and dashboards for automation success/fail and ROI.



Data and Integrations



Integrate PSA, RMM, documentation, and billing systems to ensure single source of truth (SSOT).

Build data pipelines to surface insights (e.g., ticket drivers, SLA risk, noisy alerts) and prioritize automation backlog.



Governance, Security, and Documentation



Follow change control, ITIL processes, and least-privilege access.

Document runbooks, code, and deployment patterns; enable technicians to safely run automations.



Impact and Success Metrics



Ticket reduction: decrease repeat/noise tickets and auto-resolve a targeted percentage of alerts/incidents.

Speed: reduce time-to-first-response and time-to-resolution for top incident categories.

Technician productivity: increase tickets closed per FTE; reduce after-hours escalations.

Configuration hygiene: increase baseline compliance (M365/Azure/Intune/RMM) and reduce drift.

Reliability: maintain automation success rate and rollback within defined SLOs.





Requirements

Required Qualifications



3+ years in an MSP or similar multi-tenant environment.

Strong scripting in PowerShell; working knowledge of Python.

Hands-on with at least one PSA (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask) and one RMM (NinjaOne, N-central, Kaseya, Datto RMM, Intune for device mgmt).

Microsoft 365/Azure AD/Entra/Intune administration and policy automation experience.

API experience: REST, JSON, OAuth; building integrations between PSA, RMM, documentation, and monitoring.

Version control (Git), code review, and basic CI/CD for scripts.

Understanding of ITIL incident/request/change practices and change risk management.

Strong documentation habits and ability to translate business requirements into technical automation.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience with Microsoft Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, or other RPA/iPaaS.

Infrastructure-as-code or policy-as-code exposure (e.g., Intune templates, Graph API automation).

Monitoring/observability tools (e.g., Sentinel, Log Analytics, Splunk, Datadog).

Security automation: Conditional Access, Defender for Endpoint policies, vulnerability remediation workflows.

Certifications: CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft MS-102/SC-200/MD-102, ITIL Foundation, relevant RMM/PSA certs.



Example Projects you might own:



Auto-triage: classify, enrich, and route tickets based on content, device signals, and client priority.

Self-healing: auto-restart services/processes, clear disk space, fix DNS/NTP, remediate common Windows events.

Patch orchestration: approval policies with maintenance windows and success verification.

Onboarding/offboarding: user, mailbox, license, group, device, and access automation with proof of completion.

Drift control: reconcile device and software inventories, enforce baseline configs, and update documentation automatically.

SLA risk alerts: proactive signals when SLA breaches are likely based on backlog and priority.



How You’ll Work



Collaborate with Service Desk, NOC, and Engineering to identify top automation candidates and quantify ROI.

Run discovery, design, pilot, and production rollout with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

Maintain a transparent automation backlog with business value scoring and regular stakeholder updates.

Tools you may use here

PSA: ConnectWise Manage

RMM/endpoint: ConnectWise

Microsoft 365/Azure: Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Defender, Conditional Access

Scripting and CI/CD: PowerShell, Python, GitHub/GitLab, Azure DevOps, REWST, Immybot

RPA/iPaaS: Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Zapier/Make

Monitoring/Logs: Sentinel, Log Analytics, vendor-native tools

title: Solar Sales Support Specialist
description:
Summary

A successful solar sale is only the beginning. What happens next requires exceptional communication, organization, problem-solving, and follow-through. SpartanX is seeking a highly organized, proactive Solar Sales Support Specialist to support our U.S.-based residential solar sales teams across multiple markets. This position serves as a critical link between Sales, Operations, and homeowners, ensuring project documentation is accurate, outstanding requirements are addressed, and projects move efficiently from contract signing through execution. We're looking for someone who takes ownership, understands urgency, and can navigate a fast-paced environment without sacrificing accuracy or professionalism.



What You'll Do

Sales Support & Project Coordination

- Provide daily operational and administrative support to residential solar sales representatives and sales leadership.

- Support sales representatives throughout the customer onboarding process.

- Review sales contracts, customer information, and project documentation for completeness and accuracy.

- Identify missing documentation, discrepancies, and outstanding requirements.

- Coordinate with sales representatives and homeowners to obtain necessary information.

- Monitor active projects and proactively identify issues that could impact project progression.

- Assist with coordinating site surveys, inspections, and other project milestones.



Communication & Problem Resolution

- Provide timely, professional responses to sales representatives regarding project status, requirements, and concerns.

- Communicate with homeowners regarding outstanding documentation and project updates.

- Investigate project-related issues and coordinate appropriate resolutions.

- Collaborate with Design, Engineering, Permitting, Scheduling, Installation, and Operations teams.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department and follow through until resolved.

- Maintain clear, consistent communication between Sales and Operations.



Documentation & Operational Support

- Maintain accurate customer and project records within company systems.

- Track outstanding requests, action items, and project requirements.

- Monitor project pipelines and identify stalled projects requiring additional attention.

- Assist sales leadership with reporting, administrative tasks, and operational updates.

- Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements to existing workflows.

- Maintain confidentiality when handling customer information and company documentation.



What We're Looking For

- Previous experience in sales support, project coordination, customer service, or operational administration.

- Residential solar industry experience strongly preferred.

- Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills.

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

- Strong critical-thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple requests, projects, and competing priorities simultaneously.

- Confidence communicating with sales representatives, homeowners, and operational leadership.

- Proficiency with CRM platforms, spreadsheets, and cloud-based applications.

- Ability to work independently, take initiative, and follow through without constant supervision.

- Ability to remain professional and solution-focused in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience supporting U.S.-based residential solar sales teams.

- Understanding of the residential solar project lifecycle.

- Familiarity with solar contracts, financing documentation, and customer onboarding requirements.

- Experience coordinating across multiple operational departments.

- Previous experience supporting geographically distributed teams in a remote environment.



Schedule & Work Arrangement

- Full-time, fully remote offshore position.

- Monday–Friday.

- Must be available to work designated U.S. business hours.



What SpartanX Provides

- Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.

- Ongoing training and professional development.

- Opportunities for career growth and advancement.

- Collaborative, team-focused work environment.

- Opportunity to directly impact operational efficiency, sales performance, and customer satisfaction.



Why SpartanX?

At SpartanX, we believe exceptional sales support goes beyond answering questions and updating records. It's about anticipating needs, removing obstacles, and ensuring the right people have the right information at the right time. We value individuals who take initiative, communicate clearly, solve problems, and take accountability for their work. 



If you're organized, resourceful, and thrive in an environment where your contributions make a measurable difference, we want to hear from you.



Apply Here: 



Solar Done Right.

Remote Operations Admin | Go2Care Essentials

Location

Remote, based in the Philippines



Schedule

9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. Los Angeles time, five days per week, with a one-hour break. In the Philippines, this is an overnight shift of 12:00 a.m.–8:00 a.m. during Los Angeles daylight saving time and 1:00 a.m.–9:00 a.m. during standard time.



Compensation

$450 USD per month, paid every two weeks.



Go2Care Essentials supplies everyday healthcare products to facilities and home care customers. We’re hiring a Remote Operations Admin to keep orders moving from confirmation through delivery, help new facilities get started, and keep our Managing Director informed when something needs attention.

What you’ll do

- Confirm and process orders. Review incoming orders in our Ops Center, contact customers to confirm details, resolve missing information, and keep order statuses up to date.

- Review facility applications and complete onboarding. Check applications for completeness, follow up for missing information, and help approved facilities set up their accounts and get ready to order.

- Dispatch orders and support delivery drivers. Assign deliveries, take calls from drivers who need help, confirm completed deliveries, and follow up on delays or failed attempts.

- Check inventory and coordinate with suppliers. Monitor product availability, follow up on backorders and expected arrivals, and flag anything that could delay a customer order.

- Report to the Managing Director. Share clear updates on pending orders, facility applications, deliveries, and supplier issues. Stay reachable for regular calls and check-ins during your shift.

What we’re looking for

- Excellent spoken and written English. You’ll speak directly with U.S. customers, facility staff, and delivery drivers, and write clear, professional follow-up messages.

- A fast, reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace. You’ll use our company VoIP phone for customer calls and driver support throughout the shift.

- Prompt responses during working hours. You’ll need to stay reachable by phone and on Zoho Cliq so management and drivers can get help when they need it.

- Comfort working across multiple apps. You can take a call, find the right order in the Ops Center, communicate through Zoho Cliq, and document the next step accurately.

- Quick learning and strong follow-through. You pick up new workflows quickly, stay organized, and follow open issues through to resolution.

- Availability for the Los Angeles schedule year-round, including the one-hour shift change in the Philippines.

Previous experience working with a U.S. company is preferred. Experience in customer service, order processing, dispatch, e-commerce, or supplier coordination is a plus.

One-month paid trial

The role starts with a one-month paid trial at the same rate. You’ll learn our systems and handle day-to-day work with support from the team. At the end of the month, you and the Managing Director will review how it went. If both sides agree it’s a good fit, we’ll move forward with a permanent role.

- Your experience handling customer calls, orders, or deliveries

- The systems and communication tools you’ve used

- A brief example of how you handled a delayed order or delivery

- Confirmation that you can work the Los Angeles schedule year-round

- A recent internet speed test result

You work independently, use AI tools to troubleshoot and finish assignments yourself, and deliver finished videos on schedule.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a small paid skills test (same scope, deadline, and pay for all candidates): produce one finished 15–30-second mortgage reel from supplied materials, with captions, visual movement, clean editing, and correct formatting. Deliver MP4 + editable sources.

title: Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Specialist
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer — E-Mobility & AI-Enabled Web Applications



FULL STACK DEVELOPER — AI-ENABLED WEB APPLICATIONS



Location: Remote (Philippines-based)



Position Type: Part-time to start, with a path to full-time based on performance and fit



Schedule: Aligned with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/New York); minimum 4-hour daily overlap required



Team Context: You'll join a remote team that includes an AI automation specialist (n8n, Open Claw, agent orchestration).

This role is the application-development counterpart to that function — you build the products; your teammate builds the automation glue around them. Expect close collaboration, not overlap.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We're looking for a strong/experienced full stack developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications in the electric mobility (eMobility) space — think fleet electrification dashboards, multimodal routing tools, EV education platforms, and data-driven CMS-backed sites. You'll work at the intersection of product engineering and applied AI, implementing your coding skills with tools like Claude Code, Codex/GPT, and Kimi K3 as coding and research accelerants — not as a crutch, but as a way to move faster and keep costs down. The person filling this role would also need to stay abreast of the latest updates and tools utilized in the sector. 



This is a builder role first. You should love and have experience writing clean, maintainable code, care about security, performance, and speed and be comfortable owning a feature/project from database schema to deployed UI. AI fluency is a strong plus, not the core job.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Application Development (Primary Focus)

Design and build full stack web applications and dashboards— React/Next.js (or similar) front ends connected to Node.js/Python back ends

Design and build internal systems and automations to streamline team workflows 

Architect and manage relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase) for data-intensive tools (e.g., fleet electrification calculators, EV range/charging models)

Build and maintain CMS-backed sites (Wix, headless, or custom CMS) with clean content workflows for non-technical stakeholders

Connect web apps to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, or Vercel/Render-style platforms) with attention to uptime, scalability, and cost

Implement authentication, role-based access, and security best practices appropriate for enterprise clients (OWASP basics, secure API design, data encryption at rest/in transit)

Write and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs and webhook integrations that your automation-focused teammate can plug into



AI-Accelerated Development

Use AI coding assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi K3, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality and review discipline - reviewing code before it is deployed

Exercise judgment on model selection — knowing when a lightweight/cheap model is "good enough" for boilerplate vs. when a task needs a frontier model is necessary

Collaborate with the team's AI automation specialist to expose clean APIs/webhooks so n8n and agent-based workflows can interact with your applications



SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Implement technical SEO fundamentals (site speed, structured data/schema markup, semantic HTML, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals) into everything you build

Apply GEO principles so content and app pages are legible to AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — clean information architecture, clear factual statements, structured data



Quality & Operations

Perform regular health/security audits on deployed applications and databases

Maintain documentation for architecture, environment setup, and deployment processes

Troubleshoot integration issues between your applications, the CMS, and third-party/automation tools



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Internet: High-speed connection (min. 50 Mbps) with documented backup (secondary ISP or mobile hotspot)

Computer: Mac preferred, 16GB RAM minimum (32GB+ preferred), Apple Silicon or Intel i7/i9

Audio/Video: Professional noise-canceling headset, HD webcam

Power: UPS for outage continuity

Workspace: Quiet, dedicated home office



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

3+ years professional full stack development experience, with a portfolio or GitHub showing real shipped applications (not just tutorials/clones)

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript; comfortable in at least one back-end language (Node.js, Python, or Go)

Hands-on experience with at least one modern front-end framework (React, Vue, or Next.js)

Experience designing and querying relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and comfort with at least one NoSQL option

Experience deploying and maintaining applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure/Vercel)

Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar) in a real production workflow

Working understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON — enough to integrate cleanly with an automation layer (n8n) built by a teammate

Solid grasp of web security fundamentals (auth, input validation, secrets management, HTTPS/SSL)

Exceptional written and verbal English for a U.S.-facing corporate environment



Strongly Preferred

Experience with CMS platforms — Wix Velo, Webflow, WordPress, or headless CMS (Sanity, Contentful, Strapi)

Familiarity with SEO/technical SEO and emerging GEO practices

Exposure to n8n, Zapier, Make.com, or similar — enough to speak the same language as an automation-focused teammate, even if it's not your core job

Experience with data visualization/dashboarding (D3, Recharts, Chart.js) — relevant for fleet/energy data tools

Background in EV, energy, mobility, clean tech, or logistics sectors

Experience with real-time data (WebSockets, MQTT) — relevant for fleet telemetry or charging-status use cases

Familiarity with basic DevOps/CI-CD (GitHub Actions, Docker)



Nice to Have

Mobile app experience (React Native/Flutter) if the roadmap expands to a driver/fleet-manager app

Experience with mapping/geospatial tools (Mapbox, Google Maps API, Leaflet) — common in fleet/routing tools

Prior experience working in a fully remote, async, US-hours-aligned team



APPLICATION PROCESS

Submit your application here: 



Make sure to include your resume/CV, a portfolio or GitHub link, and a cover letter answering:



Describe a full stack application you built end-to-end (front end, back end, database, deployment). What was the hardest technical decision, and why did you make it that way?



Describe a specific instance where you used an AI coding tool to meaningfully speed up a real project — what did you do, and where did you still need to step in and correct or refine the output?



(Optional but a plus) If you have any exposure to automation platforms like n8n, Zapier, or Make, briefly describe how you'd expose your application's data to one of those tools.



Also submit a 1–2 minute Loom-style video introducing yourself, walking through one project in your portfolio, and explaining why this role fits you.

title: Customer Service Admin
description:
Customer Service Administrator



Please submit a loom video of your application otherwise it may not be viewed



Who We Are



Trade Launch helps painting contractors build more profitable, organized, and scalable businesses through coaching, proven systems, training, and hands-on support.



Our clients rely on us for more than information—they expect responsive communication, clear guidance, strong organization, and consistent follow-through.



We’re looking for an exceptional Customer Service Administrator to help us deliver that experience.



This is not a passive administrative position. We need someone who takes ownership, communicates confidently, solves problems, and ensures every client feels supported throughout their journey with Trade Launch.



## The Mission



Your primary responsibility is simple:



**Deliver an organized, responsive, and professional experience for every Trade Launch client.**



You’ll serve as a central point of contact between our clients, coaches, and internal team. You’ll manage client communication, coordinate onboarding, organize meetings and information, maintain accurate records, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks.



You should be someone who can anticipate what needs to happen next and take action without requiring constant direction.



## What You’ll Own



### Client Communication



Provide prompt, friendly, and professional support to Trade Launch clients.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitoring client communication channels

* Responding to general questions and support requests

* Routing coaching, billing, or technical questions to the appropriate team member

* Following up on outstanding client requests

* Providing clients with clear updates and next steps

* Ensuring every question receives a timely response

* Maintaining a positive and helpful tone in every interaction

* Identifying urgent or sensitive concerns and escalating them appropriately



### Client Onboarding



Create a smooth and organized onboarding experience for every new client.



Responsibilities include:



* Sending welcome
s and onboarding instructions

* Scheduling onboarding and kickoff calls

* Collecting required intake forms and business information

* Ensuring clients receive access to Skool, Slack, training materials, and other resources

* Confirming that onboarding steps are completed

* Following up on missing information

* Updating internal records once onboarding is complete

* Introducing clients to the appropriate coaches and team members



### Scheduling and Calendar Coordination



Coordinate client-facing meetings across the Trade Launch team.



This includes:



* Scheduling coaching and accountability calls

* Confirming appointments

* Rescheduling calls when necessary

* Coordinating calendars between clients and coaches

* Sending reminders and meeting links

* Preventing scheduling conflicts

* Tracking missed calls, cancellations, and reschedules

* Helping clients understand where and when to attend weekly calls



### CRM and Administrative Organization



Keep client records, tasks, and communication organized and accurate.



Responsibilities include:



* Updating client profiles and contact information

* Recording important notes and client updates

* Maintaining onboarding and client-success trackers

* Organizing documents, recordings, and client resources

* Tracking action items and follow-ups

* Ensuring internal systems reflect the client’s current status

* Identifying incomplete or outdated information

* Supporting ongoing improvements to administrative workflows



### Community and Program Support



Help clients navigate the Trade Launch experience.



Responsibilities include:



* Directing clients to the correct courses, calls, resources, and support channels

* Answering questions about how the program works

* Helping clients access Skool, Slack, Zoom, and other platforms

* Posting reminders and important updates

* Monitoring the community for unanswered questions

* Keeping course links, schedules, and shared resources organized

* Ensuring clients know exactly where to go when they need help



### Client Follow-Up and Accountability



Help maintain engagement throughout the client journey.



Responsibilities include:



* Following up with clients who miss scheduled calls

* Checking in when onboarding steps remain incomplete

* Supporting coaches with client reminders and action items

* Tracking unresolved client requests

* Identifying clients who may be disengaging

* Alerting the Client Success team to potential concerns

* Making sure every open item has a clear owner and deadline



### Billing and Documentation Support



Provide administrative assistance with client accounts.



This may include:



* Routing billing questions to the appropriate team member

* Sending invoices, receipts, or payment links

* Updating account and payment records

* Following up on required documents

* Organizing signed agreements

* Maintaining confidentiality when handling client and financial information



## What We’re Looking For



We’re looking for someone who:



* Is warm, professional, and confident when communicating with clients

* Is extremely organized and detail-oriented

* Takes ownership of tasks from beginning to completion

* Responds quickly and follows up consistently

* Can manage multiple priorities without becoming overwhelmed

* Solves problems independently within established guidelines

* Is comfortable learning new technology

* Maintains accurate records and organized systems

* Knows when to resolve an issue and when to escalate it

* Handles confidential information professionally

* Brings a positive, helpful attitude to the team

* Is comfortable working in a fast-moving environment



## You’d Be a Great Fit If...



* You genuinely enjoy helping people.

* You naturally bring organization to busy environments.

* You hate leaving questions unanswered or tasks unfinished.

* You communicate clearly without sounding robotic.

* You notice small details other people miss.

* You think ahead and act before problems grow.

* You’re comfortable speaking with business owners.

* You enjoy improving processes and creating structure.

* You don’t need constant supervision to produce excellent work.

* You take pride in creating a great customer experience.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Every new client receives a smooth and professional onboarding experience.

* Client questions are answered or routed quickly.

* Coaches have the information they need before client calls.

* Client records, documents, and communication remain organized.

* Meetings are scheduled and confirmed without unnecessary confusion.

* Missed calls, incomplete forms, and unresolved requests are followed up on.

* Clients know where to find resources and who to contact for help.

* Potential client concerns are identified before they become larger problems.

* Administrative tasks are completed accurately and on time.

* No client request or internal action item falls through the cracks.



## Why Join Trade Launch?



This is an opportunity to become an important part of a growing company that is making a measurable impact on painting contractors across North America.



You’ll work closely with our clients, coaches, and leadership team while gaining exposure to client success, business coaching, sales, operations, and entrepreneurship.



You’ll have real ownership, meaningful responsibility, and the ability to directly improve the experience our clients receive.



If you love helping people, creating structure, solving problems, and ensuring every detail is handled, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Hiring: [REMOTE] Short-Form Video Editors
description:
Turn great livestream moments into content people can't stop watching.



We are looking for creative, detail-oriented, and reliable Gaming Short-Form Video Editors to join our growing production team. We work with gaming creators and livestream personalities, transforming their long-form streams into engaging short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. We are looking for editors who understand internet culture, gaming communities, and what makes people stop scrolling.



Position Details

Position: Short-Form Video Editor

Work Arrangement: Remote

Employment Type: Part-time / Freelance

Initial Trial: 1 Month

Trial Compensation: CAD $500–$650

Trial Output: 30 Completed Short-Form Video Edits



Key Responsibilities

Review authorized livestreams, long-form videos, raw footage, and other content materials to identify engaging, entertaining, and shareable moments.

Transform selected footage into compelling vertical videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Create strong hooks and compelling openings that capture viewers' attention.

Apply professional editing techniques, including dynamic captions, sound effects, transitions, zooms, pacing, color grading, and visual enhancements.

Adapt editing styles to different creators, audiences, industries, and content categories.

Maintain consistency with each client's creative direction, personality, brand identity, and content strategy.

Follow creative briefs, brand guidelines, and production standards.

Submit completed edits within agreed deadlines.

Apply feedback and revisions while maintaining consistent quality.

Organize project files and maintain an efficient editing workflow.



Content Categories

We works across multiple content categories and industries. Editors should be adaptable and comfortable working with different types of content.

Examples include:

Gaming & Streaming: Gaming highlights, livestream clips, reactions, funny moments, and creator content.

Fashion & Lifestyle: Fashion reels, outfit showcases, lifestyle content, beauty, and personal branding.

Entertainment: Reactions, commentary, viral moments, storytelling, and engaging social media content.

Business & Entrepreneurship: Business insights, educational content, podcasts, interviews, and promotional videos.

Real Estate & Luxury: Property showcases, architectural videos, luxury lifestyle, and real estate marketing.

Other Creator Content: Personal brands, influencer content, educational videos, and other short-form video formats.

Editors may initially be assigned to specific content categories depending on their strengths, experience, and the company's production requirements.



What We're Looking For

We want editors who can demonstrate:

Strong short-form video editing skills.

A good understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Excellent timing, storytelling, pacing, and creative judgment.

The ability to identify engaging moments from lengthy footage.

Creativity in using captions, sound effects, transitions, and visual elements.

The ability to adapt editing styles to different niches and audiences.

Consistency, attention to detail, and reliability.

Good communication and the ability to work independently.

Willingness to learn new editing styles and follow different creative directions.



Preferred Editing Software:

Adobe Premiere Pro

CapCut

DaVinci Resolve

Adobe After Effects



Previous experience editing creator content, gaming highlights, fashion videos, lifestyle content, podcasts, promotional videos, or other short-form formats is a strong advantage.



Compensation & Performance-Based Opportunities

The initial engagement is a one-month paid trial worth CAD $500–$650, with a target output of 30 completed video edits.

During this period, we will evaluate your:

Editing quality and creativity.

Consistency across all deliverables.

Productivity and ability to meet deadlines.

Understanding of different content styles and audiences.

Ability to follow instructions and incorporate feedback.

Communication and professionalism.

Adaptability to different client requirements.

Compensation may increase after the trial based on demonstrated performance, consistency, quality, and production needs.



We are not simply looking for temporary editors. We want to build a reliable, long-term creative team.

High-performing editors may be considered for increased responsibilities and future leadership opportunities, including:

Senior Video Editor

Lead Video Editor

Creative Team Lead

Production Supervisor

These opportunities will depend on individual performance and business requirements.



How to Apply

Interested applicants should submit the following: 

Updated resume or professional profile.

Portfolio containing at least 3–5 video editing samples.

Samples demonstrating different editing styles or content categories, if available.

Editing software and tools you currently use.

Estimated number of videos you can comfortably produce per week.



Important: Applicants must provide actual editing samples. We are particularly interested in seeing your creativity, storytelling, pacing, visual execution, and ability to adapt content to different audiences.



Selection Process

Application and portfolio screening.

Initial interview.

Final selection and onboarding.

One-month paid performance trial.

Join MomentForge Media



We are building a multi-niche content production company focused on transforming raw footage and creative ideas into engaging short-form content.



From gaming and entertainment to fashion, lifestyle, business, and beyond, our goal is to help creators and brands capture attention, strengthen their digital presence, and produce content that connects with their audiences. If you are creative, adaptable, passionate about video editing, and interested in growing with a developing media production company, we'd love to see your work.



MomentForge Media

We Turn Streams Into Moments That Matter.
