title: Social Media Reels Editor and Content Creator for a Yoga and Fitness Studio (Hourly)
description:
Simply Yoga and Fitness is a yoga, Pilates and strength studio in Carlisle, Pennsylvania (USA). We have been part of our community for more than 16 years. Our studio is warm, welcoming and full of real people getting stronger, and we want our social media to show that.



We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented editor to turn our raw photos and video clips into short, eye-catching Reels and posts that build brand awareness and bring new students through our doors. We upload footage to a shared Google Drive, and you turn it into content people stop scrolling for.



This is an hourly role to start, about 5 to 10 hours a week. If it is a great fit, we would love to grow it into a steady, long-term position.



THE GOAL



Our social media has one main job: attract the right new students and encourage them to try our intro offer. Likes and views are nice, but what matters most is real people reaching out, clicking to book, and walking through our door.



Every piece of content should help someone local think, "That looks like a place for me," and give them an easy next step. Our team handles follow-up and memberships. Your role is to create content that gets the right people to raise their hand.



WHAT YOU WILL CREATE



Video Reels (15 to 60 seconds)

- Edit our raw video clips into short Reels with trending or upbeat music

- Cut clips to the beat so the energy matches the music

- Add clean text overlays, captions and simple transitions

- Highlight our instructors, classes, members and studio atmosphere



Photo Reels (beat-sync and montage style)

- Turn groups of photos into beat-synced photo Reels where images flash in time with the music

- Use Instagram Reel templates when they fit

- Create "photo dump" and behind-the-scenes style Reels from class and event photos



Student Testimonial Reels

- Edit short video testimonials from our students into clean, engaging Reels of 30 to 60 seconds

- Put the strongest moment or quote in the first 3 seconds to hook viewers

- Add on-screen captions so videos work without sound

- Turn written reviews and quotes into branded graphic posts in Canva

- Pair testimonials with class footage to show the real experience behind the words



Educational Reels

- Edit short teaching videos where our instructors demonstrate a breathing technique, a pose, or how to do a movement safely

- Add clear on-screen text labels for steps and cues (for example "Step 1: Ground your feet" or "Keep your knees soft")

- Turn tips into save-worthy carousel posts, like "3 ways to protect your lower back in yoga"

- Make each video feel approachable and encouraging for beginners, never intimidating

- Keep instruction accurate by using the instructor's exact cues and never adding your own teaching



Static and Carousel Posts

- Design single-image and carousel posts in Canva using our brand colors and logo

- Create graphics for class schedules, new programs, events and promotions



Captions and Posting

- Write short, warm, encouraging captions that speak to real problems our students face (no routine, fear of getting hurt, wanting to feel strong again)

- End posts with a clear call to action that points people to our intro offer (book your first class, send us a message, tap the link to get started)

- Use searchable keywords in captions, on-screen text and alt text (for example "yoga in Carlisle PA," "Pilates for beginners," "strength training over 40") so people searching Instagram and Google can find us

- Add 2 or 3 local hashtags when they fit (like #CarlislePA)

- Avoid exaggerated health or weight-loss claims

- Schedule approved posts on Instagram and
 through Meta Business Suite

- Post weekly updates to our Google Business Profile





APPROVAL AND ACCESS

- All content is reviewed and approved by the owner before it is published

- You will submit finished content to our shared Google Drive (Ready for Review) each week

- Once approved, you will schedule posts in Meta Business Suite

- You will be given limited access to our
, Instagram and Google Business Profile accounts through business tools. We never share passwords.

- As trust builds, approval for everyday posts may become more flexible



CONTENT THEMES WE FOCUS ON

- Real instructors teaching and giving hands-on guidance

- Student testimonials and real transformation stories

- Education: breathing practices, pose breakdowns and moving safely

- Member milestones and celebrations

- Strength, low-impact movement and feeling good in your body

- Helping people who feel stuck, busy or unsure find a routine they love

- Our community: events, workshops and local partnerships

- New programs, like our Restore Your Core series

- Our intro offer and what a first visit looks like



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong portfolio of short-form Reels for a business or brand (required)

- Experience creating content that brings in leads or bookings, not just views (strongly preferred)

- Skilled in CapCut, InShot, Premiere Rush or a similar editing app

- Confident with Canva

- Knows how to use music legally on a business account (Instagram's licensed audio library or royalty-free music)

- Understands keyword-based captions and current Instagram best practices

- Familiar with Meta Business Suite

- Excellent written English that sounds natural to an American audience

- Reliable, organized and comfortable working from a shared Google Drive

- Tracks hours honestly with a time tracker (Toggl, Clockify or similar)

- Strongly preferred: a personal practice or professional background in yoga, Pilates, fitness or wellness



WHAT WE OFFER

- Flexible hours you set around a weekly posting schedule

- A steady supply of real footage from a busy, positive studio

- Creative freedom within our brand

- Room to grow into more hours and responsibility over time



HOW TO APPLY

1. Put "Strong and Steady" as the first line of your message, so we know you read the whole post

2. Send links to at least 3 Reels you have edited for a business, including at least one photo Reel or beat-sync Reel if you have one. If any of your content brought in leads or bookings, tell us about it.

3. Tell us about your connection to fitness or wellness (do you practice yoga, Pilates, or another movement style?), and in 2 or 3 sentences, how you would make a beginner yoga class look inviting to someone who has never tried yoga

4. Share your hourly rate, your weekly availability, the editing apps you use, and your preferred payment method



Shortlisted applicants will complete a small paid test: one video Reel, one photo Reel and two captions, made from our studio footage.
salary: $4 to $7 per hour, based on experience

title: Appointment Setter (B2B SaaS)
description:
About Riovis

Riovis is marketing software that helps direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands manage their marketing activities from one platform.



With Riovis, businesses can:

- Plan campaigns and manage content calendars.

- Create social posts, graphics and short-form videos, then schedule them across social channels.

 campaigns and manage subscriber lists.

The Role

Your primary responsibility is to find potential customers in the skincare, beauty, fashion, clothing and footwear industries, initiate conversations with business owners and marketing decision-makers, qualify their interest, and book product demonstrations with our sales team.



Our target customers range from independently operated, founder-led businesses to established brands with teams of up to 100 employees.



This is an outbound prospecting role suited to someone who is comfortable researching businesses, starting conversations and consistently generating qualified sales opportunities.

What You'll Do

- Research and build targeted lead lists using ecommerce databases, Instagram, TikTok, wholesale marketplaces, trade show exhibitor directories and other prospecting sources.

title: Patient Accounts Reconciliation Specialist (PRN Contractor)
description:
The Purpose of Your Role   



The primary objective of this project is to research, identify, and accurately post unallocated payments, credits, and undistributed funds within our patient accounting system. You will investigate historical transactions, resolve variances, and ensure that patient accounts reflect precise, up-to-date financial balances in compliance with company policies and healthcare regulations. 





The Company You’ll Join 



OCD Anxiety Centers is the nation’s largest provider of IOP services for individuals dealing with OCD, Anxiety, and Trauma. As the leading provider, our clinical outcomes are second to none. You will join a winning team that is committed to evidence-based treatment and long-term results. We are passionate about bringing help and hope to some of the most underserved clinical populations. We strive to change the lives of individuals and their families suffering from unrelenting anxiety, disturbing and terrifying thoughts, uncontrollable worry, exhausting behaviors and rituals, and avoidance that keeps them from living their lives. We are an evidence-based practice, which means we do what works, stay current with scientific research, and regularly attend international training to keep us at our very best. Our values are as follows:  



Growth 

Proactivity 

Positivity 

Results Driven 





Our Investment in You 

A competitive base salary starting at $9 to $11 per hour 





Responsibilities 



Research Unallocated Monies: Audit patient accounts to identify the root cause of unallocated payments,  

 overpayments, unidentified clearinghouse credits, and misapplied funds. 



Accurate Payment Posting: Post, adjust, and reallocate payments to correct patient encounters or line items in accordance with explanation of benefits (EOBs), remittances, and patient receipts. 



Account Reconciliation: Balance and reconcile daily or batch posting workflows against bank deposits and financial system logs. 



Error Resolution: Identify systemic trends causing unallocated balances (e.g., clearinghouse issues, front-desk collection errors) and report findings to management. 



Compliance Management: Ensure all adjustments, refunds, or balance transfers strictly adhere to HIPAA guidelines, internal control procedures, and healthcare billing compliance standards. 



Adheres to all company policies and procedures 



Other duties as assigned 



 



Qualifications 



Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in healthcare medical billing, patient accounts receivable, or healthcare payment posting. 



Technical Skills: High proficiency with Electronic Health Record (EHR) and practice management software (e.g., Epic, Cerner, eClinicalWorks, or similar billing platforms). Advanced Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) are highly preferred. 



Knowledge Base: Strong understanding of medical billing terminology, EOB interpretation, coordination of benefits (COB), and healthcare accounting practices. 



Attributes: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and auditing skills; ability to work independently with minimal supervision. 



 



Project Timeline & Performance KPIs 



Should this contract extend, performance will be evaluated against the following milestones to measure efficiency, speed, and accuracy: 



 



30-Day KPIs (Onboarding & Accuracy Baseline) 



 Complete standard system training and demonstrate proficiency in navigating the practice management ledger. 



 Establish a steady daily review cadence, auditing a minimum of 35-40 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Maintain a posting and reconciliation accuracy rate of 99% or higher on all audited accounts. 



 



60-Day KPIs (Volume Acceleration & Error Reduction) 



 Increase daily workflow throughput to audit and resolve a minimum of 45–50 unallocated transactions per day. 



 Achieve a posting accuracy rate of 99% or higher with minimal supervision or need for posting reversals. 



 Successfully identify, categorize, and document at least two major root causes of systemic unallocated funds to assist the permanent team in preventative measures. 





Note: This is a PRN (as-needed) position, meaning there is no fixed work schedule or guaranteed number of hours.

title: Media Buyer
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines-Based Contractor

Compensation: To be discussed in upon interview

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 6:00 AM–3:00 PM Pacific Time (PST/PDT)

Hours: 40 hours per week | 8 working hours daily with a required 1-hour unpaid lunch break



ABOUT APPAID 

AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



ABOUT THE ROLE

AppAid is seeking an experienced, analytical, and results-driven Media Buyer to manage and optimize our paid advertising campaigns, with a primary focus on Google Ads and Meta Ads 
 & Instagram).

This role will be responsible for driving consistent, high-quality lead generation through strategic campaign management, audience targeting, budget optimization, and ongoing performance analysis.

While Google and Meta will be the primary advertising platforms, the ideal candidate should also be comfortable managing and expanding campaigns across TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), and other relevant digital advertising channels.

We are looking for someone who understands that successful advertising goes beyond generating clicks and impressions. Our priority is attracting qualified leads, improving conversion rates, and maximizing the return on our advertising investment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Paid Advertising & Campaign Management

- Develop, launch, manage, and optimize lead generation campaigns primarily across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Manage additional advertising channels, including TikTok Ads, Microsoft Advertising (Bing), and other platforms as needed.

- Oversee daily campaign performance, advertising budgets, bidding strategies, audience targeting, and ad placements.

- Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience research to identify new opportunities.

- Implement retargeting and remarketing strategies to improve lead conversions.

- Monitor campaign performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve efficiency and scale successful campaigns.



Lead Generation & Conversion Optimization

Focus on generating qualified leads while maintaining competitive cost-per-lead (CPL) and cost-per-acquisition (CPA) metrics.

Continuously test ad copy, creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaign structures to improve results.

Collaborate with internal teams to evaluate lead quality and optimize campaigns based on actual lead outcomes.

Identify and address underperforming campaigns, inefficient spending, and conversion bottlenecks.

Recommend strategies to improve lead volume, conversion rates, and overall advertising performance.



Tracking, Analytics & Reporting

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Meta Ads Manager, and other relevant tracking tools.

- Maintain accurate conversion tracking, including pixels, events, and attribution where applicable.

- Prepare regular performance reports highlighting advertising spend, leads generated, CPL, conversion rates, and other key metrics.

- Provide actionable recommendations based on campaign data and performance trends.

- Work with internal teams to ensure advertising performance aligns with business objectives.



Creative Strategy & Collaboration

- Collaborate with internal creative and marketing teams to develop effective ad creatives, messaging, and campaign concepts.

- Provide feedback on creative performance and recommend new concepts based on advertising data.

- Conduct A/B testing to identify high-performing messaging, visuals, and audience combinations.

- Stay informed on advertising platform updates, policies, and emerging opportunities.





QUALIFICATIONS

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns, specifically Google Ads and Meta Ads.

- Demonstrated experience running lead generation campaigns, not solely e-commerce or brand awareness campaigns.

- Strong understanding of Google Search campaigns, Meta lead generation campaigns, conversion tracking, and campaign optimization.

- Experience managing advertising budgets and making data-driven decisions to improve campaign performance.

- Proficiency with Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.

- Ability to analyze campaign performance and communicate results clearly.

- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple campaigns simultaneously.

- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of campaign performance, and proactively recommend improvements.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience managing TikTok Ads and Microsoft Advertising (Bing).

- Experience with lead generation for service-based businesses, legal services, or other high-intent consumer services.

- Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM platforms for tracking lead quality and conversion outcomes.

- Experience with landing page optimization and A/B testing.

- Knowledge of offline conversion tracking and CRM-based attribution.

- Google Ads or Meta Blueprint certifications.



WORK SCHEDULE AND EXPECTATION

This is a full-time, remote contractor position based in the Philippines, requiring active availability during AppAid's U.S. Pacific Time business hours.



Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 AM–3:00 PM Pacific Time.

- 10:00 PM–7:00 AM Philippine Time (PHT, UTC+8)

- Daily Hours: 8 working hours with a required 1-hour unpaid lunch break.

- Time Zone: Candidates must be comfortable working overnight hours in the Philippines to align with our California-based team.

- Communication: Active and consistent communication with internal teams during scheduled working hours is required.

- Accountability: Candidates must be comfortable independently managing assigned responsibilities, meeting deadlines, and providing regular campaign updates.





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The ideal candidate is someone who takes ownership of their campaigns, understands the importance of lead quality, and is constantly looking for opportunities to improve results.

We value someone who is proactive, analytical, dependable, and comfortable communicating directly with our team. Rather than simply maintaining existing campaigns, we want someone who can identify opportunities, recommend improvements, and help AppAid grow its lead generation efforts through effective paid advertising strategies.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
EDUSFERE

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

K–12 Independent Schools  |  Work From Home (Philippines-Based)  |  Full-Time Hours | US School Hours



About the Role



Edusfere is a B2B SaaS edtech company that offers cutting-edge curriculum mapping software for K–12 schools. We are looking for a driven and articulate Sales Development Representative to work with our team as an independent contractor, engaged directly by Edusfere (no agency). In this role, you will be the first point of contact for independent K–12 schools primarily in the United States, plus selected international markets, generating qualified pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting and inbound lead management.



The ideal candidate brings B2B sales experience in SaaS or edtech, and direct experience in education, either as a former teacher, school administrator, or someone who has sold products and services into K–12 schools. You understand the language of educators, the rhythms of the school year, and how purchase decisions are made at independent schools. This domain expertise, paired with strong sales acumen and clear, confident English, will set you apart.



Key Responsibilities



* Outbound prospecting: Research target schools and contact school leaders (Heads of School, Principals, Directors of Learning) by phone,
, and LinkedIn, using lead lists and outreach campaigns we provide, to generate qualified demos.

Inbound lead management: Respond to and qualify inbound leads in a timely manner; assess fit, educate prospects on Edusfere’s value proposition, and book qualified demos with our sales lead.

* Book demos: Qualify interest and book qualified demos with our sales lead. After approval, run demos and sales conversations through to signed contracts.

* Callbacks and inquiries: Respond promptly to schools that call back or reply.

* CRM: Log every call, note, and outcome in HubSpot the same day.

* Feedback: Share what you hear from schools each week so we can improve our pitch and targeting.

* Market intelligence: Stay current on trends in independent school education, edtech adoption, and competitive landscape to refine messaging and targeting.



Required Qualifications



* 2+ years of experience in a sales, business development, or SDR role with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding quota.

* Native or near-native English proficiency with excellent written and verbal communication skills—you must be able to hold natural, confident conversations with US-based school leaders.

* Proficiency with CRM tools (HubSpot or similar).

* Available about 8 hours a day, Monday–Friday, on a schedule you set within US school hours (8:00 AM Eastern to 5:00 PM Pacific, roughly 9:00 PM–9:00 AM PHT).

* Work-from-home setup: reliable internet of at least 25 Mbps, backup internet (e.g. mobile data or pocket Wi-Fi) and backup power, a noise-cancelling headset, a webcam, a mobile phone, a quiet workspace, and a laptop or desktop in good working condition with a secure operating system and antivirus.

* Registered, or willing to register, with the BIR as self-employed.



Preferred Qualifications



* Direct experience in the K–12 education sector: prior work as a classroom teacher, school administrator, admissions officer, or in an education-focused sales role.

* Experience selling into schools, school districts, or education institutions (independent, private, or international schools preferred).

* Familiarity with international school markets (Asia, Middle East, Latin America, Europe).

* Background in edtech, SaaS, or education services sales.

* Bachelor’s degree in Education, Business, Communications, or a related field.



What Success Looks Like



* After ramp-up, consistently booking 15–20+ qualified demos per month with school decision-makers (Heads of School, Directors of Learning, Directors of Curriculum, or similar titles).

* Building a healthy pipeline of opportunities across US independent schools, plus selected international markets.

* Becoming a trusted first impression of Edusfere—school leaders feel they are speaking with someone who genuinely understands their world.

* Contributing insights from the front lines that improve Edusfere’s messaging, targeting, and go-to-market strategy.



Fees & Incentives



* Monthly fee: ₱45,000–65,000, depending on experience.

* Uncapped incentive pay: Under our current Sales Incentive Plan, a bonus for every qualified demo held, plus commission on deals that close.

* Training: Paid onboarding on our product, the US school market, and our sales process.

* Growth: A path to closing deals yourself at a higher commission rate, and into a senior sales role as Edusfere scales.

* Work from home: Fully remote; no commute.

* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on transforming K–12 education.



How to Apply



If you are passionate about education and thrive in a fast-paced sales environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit:

* Your resume.

* A brief cover note explaining your B2B sales experience, any connection to education, and why this role interests you.

* A 60-second voice recording introducing yourself in English.

* A screenshot of a recent internet speed test.



Engagement type: This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment. The selected candidate will provide services under an Independent Contractor Agreement with Edusfere, LLC, a US company, and will not be an employee of Edusfere or of any Philippine entity. You will set your own schedule within US school hours and decide how and where you perform the work. As an independent contractor, you will be responsible for your own taxes and BIR registration, government contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), equipment, internet, and workspace. You will not be entitled to employee benefits such as leave, 13th-month pay, overtime, holiday pay, or night-shift differential. Fees are paid monthly in Philippine pesos against your invoice. You may provide services to other clients, provided there is no conflict of interest.



Edusfere welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and is committed to equal opportunity.

title: Job Listing — All-Round E-Commerce Virtual Assistant
description:
About us

We're a fast-scaling UK e-commerce brand, doing around £600,000/month and pushing hard past it. Direct-to-consumer on Shopify, driven primarily by paid social. We're preparing a US launch and building the team and systems to scale aggressively into Q4 and beyond.



The founder runs lean and moves fast. Decisions are made quickly, standards are high, and everything is built with intent — nothing exists in this business "just because". You'd be working directly with the founder, inside the engine room of a brand in genuine growth mode.



The role

This is an all-round executive VA role. You are the founder's right hand online - the person who takes every piece of operational & admin work off his plate so he can stay focused on growth.



This is not a narrow, ticket-based VA job. The brief is deliberately broad: if it can be done from a laptop and it needs doing, it's yours. Some days that's spreadsheets and data entry; other days it's chasing suppliers, organising files, managing inboxes, pulling research, or setting up a tool from scratch.



You will be logged into core business systems and trusted with sensitive access. That trust is the foundation of this role - we vet hard for it, and we reward it with real responsibility and long-term stability. 



What you'll be doing

A non-exhaustive flavour of the work:

• Operations admin - keeping our project management system asana updated and organised; building and maintaining SOPs; tracking tasks across the team; chasing loose ends so nothing slips.



• Inbox & comms support - triaging
 and messages, drafting replies, coordinating with team members, agencies, and suppliers on the founder's behalf.



• E-commerce admin - Shopify back-office tasks: orders, products, apps, basic store housekeeping; supporting fulfilment and supply chain follow-ups.



• Data & reporting - pulling numbers from our tools, maintaining trackers and spreadsheets, preparing simple reports so decisions can be made fast.



• Creative & marketing support - organising creative assets, uploading and labelling content, supporting creator outreach admin, prepping briefs and files for editors.



• General admin work - file organisation, account setups, scheduling, documentation, and the hundred small things that keep a fast-moving business tight.



• Onboarding & Offboarding team members according to SOP



• Operating my calendar



• Ongoing candidate search for job roles



The mix will shift as the business scales. What won't change: you own the details so the founder doesn't have to.

Who you are



• Genuinely sharp. You pick things up fast, connect dots without being walked through them, and can be given an outcome rather than a checklist. If something's ambiguous, you make a sensible call or ask one good question — not ten.



• Trustworthy to the core. You'll hold logins to real business systems. Discretion, honesty, and reliability are non-negotiable. References will be checked.



• You get the vision. You understand you're joining a brand that intends to scale hard, and you work like it — urgency, ownership, no "that's not my job".



• Obsessively organised. Nothing you own gets dropped. You keep systems tidier than you found them.



• A strong communicator in English. Clear, concise written updates. You lead with the answer — TLDR first, detail after.



• AI & Digitally native. You can learn any tool quickly. Experience with Shopify, Asana, Slack, or e-commerce generally is a big plus, not a requirement.



• Proactive. You spot what needs doing before being asked. When told how we like something done once, you remember it permanently.



Tools you'll touch

Shopify, Asana, Slack, WhatsApp, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Google Workspace, plus various e-commerce and AI tools as needed. You don't need to know them all on day one — you need to be the kind of person who can open a new tool and be competent in it within a week.



The details

• Location: Fully remote. Significant working-hours overlap with UK time required.

• Hours: Full-time preferred; exceptional part-time candidates considered.

• Pay: Competitive for your market, tracked hourly, paid monthly, with growth tied to performance. Top performers get more responsibility and more money — we promote from within as we scale.

• Start: As soon as possible.



How to apply

Send us:

1.  A short cover note (max 150 words) on why this role fits you — TLDR style, answer first.

NOTE - this job posting is written using AI, your cover note cannot be! Although I am looking for someone who is completely AI native, I do not want to read through hundreds of AI cover letters!

2.  Your CV.

3.  One example of a time you took something messy and made it organised — 2–3 sentences.

4.  Start your application with the word "Calm" so we know you read this properly.

Applications that ignore the instructions won't be read. Attention to detail starts here.

title: Orthodontic Insurance & Patient Coordinator (Remote)
description:
Location: Remote, Philippines-based candidates only

Schedule: Monday to Wednesday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Thursday 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM (approx. 40 hours/week). Long-term role with hours expected to increase for the right person.

Work Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Overnight schedule in the Philippines)

Compensation: $7.00 to $9.00 USD/hour (based on experience)

 

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, warm, and experienced Orthodontic Insurance Coordinator with Phones experience to join our remote team supporting a U.S. orthodontic practice!



In this role, you will take ownership of the practice’s front-end insurance workflow—including eligibility verification, claim submissions, follow-ups, and insurance A/R. You will also manage Medicaid claims from submission all the way through payment posting and EOB uploads.



Beyond billing, you’ll serve as our friendly back-end phone support for the scheduling coordinator—answering incoming calls, booking appointments from a simple template, and gracefully handling patients or parents running late.

This is a stable, long-term growth role designed for someone who wants to master practice revenue cycles and expand into deeper back-end tasks (like denials and appeals) over time.



What You’ll Do

1. Insurance (Front End): Verify patient orthodontic/dental insurance eligibility and benefits before visits, submit claims accurately, follow up on aging/unpaid claims, and keep insurance A/R moving.

2. Medicaid Management: Submit Medicaid claims, post payments accurately, and upload EOBs to the correct patient charts.

3. Growth Path (Back End): Handle denials/rejections and prepare corrected claims and appeals as you build mastery.

4. Phone Support: Back up the scheduling coordinator by taking calls, booking appointments using office templates, and managing late arrivals with a friendly, professional tone.

5. Communication & Documentation: Maintain clean, detailed notes on claims/calls and keep both our remote team and the U.S. office updated proactively.



What You Must Have (The Essentials)

1. Experience: 1+ year of hands-on U.S. orthodontic or dental insurance billing experience (eligibility, claims, follow-ups, and A/R).

2. Medicaid Experience: Hands-on experience submitting Medicaid claims, posting payments, and uploading EOBs.

3. Communication & Phone Skills: A warm, confident, and natural phone presence with U.S. patients/parents, combined with the ability to book appointments live during calls.

4. Responsiveness: Clear, proactive communication and fast response times without needing to be chased.

5. Attention to Detail: Impeccable data entry and posting accuracy.

6. Technical Setup: Reliable high-speed internet, a backup power/internet plan, and a quiet workspace free from background noise for calls.



Nice to Haves

1. Specialized orthodontic billing experience (TIP claims, payment installments, lifetime maximums, age limits).

2. Familiarity with orthodontic/dental software or clearinghouses (Ortho2 Edge, OrthoTrac, Dolphin, Open Dental, Dentrix, Curve, DentalXChange).

3. Prior exposure to denials, appeals, and full-cycle revenue management.



How to Apply

To make sure you are a great fit and pay attention to detail, please submit all 4 items below when applying. Incomplete applications cannot be reviewed.



1. Resume Link: A viewable link via Google Drive or Dropbox. (Make sure sharing permissions are set to "Anyone with the link can view").

2. Experience Paragraph (4–6 sentences): Briefly cover:

     Your U.S. ortho/dental insurance billing and front-end experience.

     Your Medicaid experience (which states and tasks handled).

     Any phone or scheduling experience with U.S. callers.

3. Claim Success Example: A short written description (3–4 sentences) of a claim or A/R problem you personally solved (The Issue, What You Did, and The Result).

4. Voice Sample Link: A link to a 60-to-90 second recording (using Vocaroo, Loom, etc.) handling this scenario:



"A parent calls to say they will be 15 minutes late for their child’s braces adjustment, and the schedule is tight." (Please start by briefly introducing yourself as if answering the office phone).



Please confirm in your application message that you are comfortable with the U.S. overnight shift schedule.

title: Healthcare Operations & Growth Manager (Remote, Philippines)
description:
Help Build a Healthcare Organization — Not Just Run One



LIVE is a physician-owned healthcare organization in Alabama, United States — a medical clinic, a dental practice, and a growing membership-based care program. We are looking for an exceptional operations leader in the Philippines to become the manager our founder-physician currently has to be, and to help build what LIVE will become.



This is not a virtual assistant role. It is a leadership position with real decision-making authority.



What makes this opportunity different:

- Real authority, not task lists. You will own routine administrative decisions, set operational priorities, and lead people, with authority expanding as you demonstrate competence.

- Direct collaboration with the physician-founder, who expects you to bring your own analysis — including opportunities he has not yet seen.

- Sophisticated infrastructure. LIVE runs on LIVE Work, our proprietary operating system for management intelligence, accountability, employee development, and institutional knowledge. Part of your job is making it produce the intelligence it was built to produce.

- A builder's mandate. Available clinical capacity, former patients who can be reactivated, a membership program ready to grow, and a founder with more initiatives than management capacity to execute them.

- Growth that is recognized. Structured compensation reviews, with progression tied to demonstrated contribution, expanding responsibility, and the organization's financial capacity.



The role: You will initially lead administrative operations and growth for LIVE Clinic (medical). Expansion to LIVE Dental follows demonstrated competence, measurable contribution, team relationships, and available capacity. You will set daily and weekly priorities; lead, coach, and develop our administrative team remotely, earning trust where staff have historically reported directly to the founder; grow revenue from existing capacity first — appointment utilization, patient reactivation, membership growth and retention, and acquisition systems that connect marketing to collected revenue; steward finances with real visibility into budgets, purchasing, and vendor performance, coordinated with independent bookkeeping; reconcile what records say against what people report and fix systems rather than repeatedly fixing instances; and independently discover opportunities to advance the organization.



Who this is for: We prioritize demonstrated intelligence, judgment, initiative, and commercial competence. Healthcare operations leadership is valued, and we also welcome exceptional candidates from adjacent backgrounds — business operations and development, chief of staff or fractional COO roles, financially oriented operational management, and entrepreneurial or organizational growth leadership — even where healthcare management experience is limited. What matters most: independent judgment with incomplete information; initiative and ownership; interpersonal leadership that corrects while preserving dignity; financial intelligence that distinguishes gross revenue from collected revenue and contribution margin; exceptional written and spoken English; and AI used as a genuine, critical extension of your own thinking.



Working hours: LIVE operates on U.S. Central Time. The Philippines is 13–14 hours ahead, so Alabama business hours fall during Philippine nighttime (approximately 9:00/10:00 PM–6:00/7:00 AM Philippine time, depending on U.S. daylight saving). Core live overlap with Alabama business hours is required. Please apply only if a night-oriented schedule is genuinely sustainable for you.



Compensation: $1,800–$2,500/month on a full-time basis for the target profile. Exceptional candidates above the band will be considered on evidence, and exceptional part-time arrangements will be considered on their merits. The formal engagement structure and all material terms will be resolved following legal review and communicated in full before any offer is made. Finalists invited to our paid assessment stage receive $75 USD; the complete assessment process takes approximately 3 hours 20 minutes in total (a written case study of about 90 minutes plus a live session), and we will communicate the full commitment clearly before it begins.



Selection process: application with evidence of real accomplishments, structured interviews, verification of experience and references, a paid operational case study with a live defense and practical exercises, and a final founder interview. AI use is permitted throughout — we evaluate your thinking, including how intelligently you use AI.



HOW TO APPLY — please include all of the following:

1. Your résumé.

2. Question 1: Describe one operational problem you owned end-to-end — the facts, your decision, and what measurably changed.

3. Question 2: Describe an opportunity to improve revenue, profitability or organizational performance that you independently identified without being asked. What did you do, and what were the measurable results?

4. AI disclosure: State whether you used AI in preparing your application responses, which tools, and which parts are AI-assisted. AI use is welcome; transparency and intellectual ownership are expected.

5. Your availability for U.S. Central Time hours, and your compensation expectation.

title: Customer Support Specialist – clear communicator, quick to reply | Shopify fashion stores | $4/hr
description:
We run a group of online fashion stores on Shopify, selling to customers in the US, Australia and Europe. Our Customer Support Lead handles support for all our stores, and we're growing. We're looking for one more person to work with him: someone calm, clear and reliable, who takes ownership and doesn't give up on a customer.



We care more about who you are than about your CV. We can teach you our tools and our way of working. What we can't teach is staying calm when a customer threatens you, and owning your work when something goes wrong.



This is a part-time role of about 20 hours a week, spread over every day. Most of our customers are in the US, so your hours need to work for US hours. You plan them together with our Customer Support Lead. What matters most to us: you communicate clearly and you're easy to reach. When the team or a customer needs you, you reply fast.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Answer customer
s for all our stores. You use AI to draft and translate, and you check every reply before you send it.

- Calm down angry customers and solve their problem, also when they threaten a bad review or a chargeback. You're never alone: you can always hand a case to our Customer Support Lead.

- Solve order problems: late or missing tracking, wrong items, wrong size or color, damaged items.

- Save the sale where it's fair: offer an exchange or a partial refund within our refund steps before a full refund. Bigger refunds go to our Customer Support Lead. When we made the mistake, we make it right straight away.

- Update orders in Shopify accurately.

- Flag problems early: if a product keeps getting complaints or runs out of stock, you tell the team the same day.

- Keep your cases up to date, so nothing gets lost.

- Some customers write in French or Italian. You reply with AI translation and check it by translating it back to English. You don't need to speak those languages.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Clear and fast communication, with customers and with the team.

- Easy to reach. You check your messages often and reply quickly. Time you spend on this is logged and paid.

- Calm under pressure. A rude or threatening customer doesn't shake you. You stay friendly, firm and focused on the solution.

- Ownership. When you get a task, you finish it. When you make a mistake, you say so and fix it.

- Good written and spoken English.

- At least 6 months of customer support for an online store. Shopify is a plus.

- You use AI tools like ChatGPT, and you always check what they write.

- Stable internet and a backup for power outages.

- ID Proof on your OnlineJobs profile.



WHAT WE OFFER

- $4/hour to start, about 20 hours a week, paid weekly through Wise for the hours you log.

- Raises up to $4.50/hour based on results: fast replies, happy customers and fewer chargebacks. We explain the targets in the interview.

- Good people get more hours as we grow.

- Paid training with our Customer Support Lead. All training hours are paid.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words CALM AND CLEAR, then answer these 5 points. Please use your own words: we'd rather hear your real story with a few mistakes than a perfect answer from AI.



1. A voice recording of 1 to 2 minutes (for example on Vocaroo or Google Drive). Introduce yourself in a few sentences. Then tell us about the hardest customer you ever handled: what they said, what you did, how it ended, and how you felt afterwards. Paste the link and make sure it opens without a login.

2. A mistake you made at work: what happened, how soon did you tell your team lead, and what did you change after?

3. What would your last team lead say is your best quality, and one thing you should improve?

4. Your experience in 2 or 3 lines: which stores or companies, which tools, and about how many
s a day.

5. Which hours (Manila time) can you usually work, every day including weekends? How fast do you usually reply to a message from your team? And when can you start?



Applications without CALM AND CLEAR or without the voice recording will not be read.

title: Client Care and Office Coordinator
description:
Client Care and Office Coordinator at Boulder Pro Painters



This is a remote, long-term opportunity. You’ll start part-time, with the potential to move to full-time.



Starting schedule: 20 hours a week, Monday through Friday, generally 8 a.m. to noon Denver time. That’s an overnight shift in the Philippines.



Starting pay: You’ll earn $5 USD per hour from day one, including your first 30 days of paid, hands-on onboarding. Boulder Pro Painters covers the payment transaction fees, so you receive the full $5 USD for every hour you work. The peso equivalent varies with the exchange rate.



Pay schedule: You’ll be paid every two weeks for the hours you worked, with your first payment after your first two weeks. At 20 hours per week, that comes to $200 USD per pay period.



Hi, I’m Jonathan, owner of Boulder Pro Painters in Boulder, Colorado. When I’m visiting a project, I want the homeowner who calls our office to reach someone who takes a moment to listen. Sometimes they’re planning their first painting project and have questions. Sometimes they just need to know when someone will get back to them. If you enjoy being that person for someone, I’d love to hear from you.



What you’ll do



You’ll answer calls, texts, and
s in English, ask homeowners about their projects, and help them take the next step. You’ll schedule estimates, confirm appointments, and keep notes and project documents organized so we can pick up where the last conversation left off. I’ll handle pricing and technical questions.



We’ll give you the tools to do the work well, including GoHighLevel, AI, and automation. Once you know how we work, I’d welcome your ideas. If you notice we’re entering the same information twice, or there’s an easier way to keep track of appointments, speak up. What matters is that the details are accurate and the homeowner is taken care of.



Your first 30 days and what comes next



I’ll show you how I handle an estimate inquiry. Then you’ll take a call, record what the homeowner needs, and we’ll talk through it together. You’ll get to put that feedback into practice on your next one. You can learn the painting business here. What I’m looking for from the start is someone who listens, asks questions when something is unclear, and takes ownership of their work.



You can expect the same openness from me. If I ask you to improve something, I’ll explain what I saw and what a better result looks like. If something goes wrong, I want you to feel comfortable telling me early so we can put things right together.



At the end of 30 days, we’ll sit down and talk about how the work is going for both of us. If you’re handling the responsibilities well and we have enough work to support a full-time schedule, we’ll discuss making that transition together. Beyond onboarding, we’ll review your progress every three months. As the company grows and you take on more responsibility, there’s an opportunity to grow into an Office Manager role.



How to apply



If this sounds like a good fit, please read the application instructions carefully. I’ll only review complete applications. Please send all three items together.



1. Your résumé or a brief work history. Please confirm that the $5 USD hourly rate and starting schedule work for you, and let me know whether you’d be open to moving to full-time after the 30-day review.

    Are you currently working for another employer or client? If you’re selected, what’s the earliest date you could start? Please factor in any notice you’d need to give and let me know how much time you’d need.

2. A fresh video for this opening, up to two minutes long. Tell me what interests you about working here and one experience that’s prepared you for the role. Then imagine you’ve answered the phone and Sarah says, “Hi, I’m thinking about painting my living room. Before I schedule an estimate, can you tell me roughly what it’ll cost?” This is Sarah’s first call, and that’s all she’s shared so far. What would you say next? Speak directly to Sarah in your own words, just as you would on the phone. A simple phone recording is great. Just check that your link opens.

3. One short written example. Tell me about a time you kept records organized and made sure someone received a follow-up. How did you keep track? If AI or automation helped, tell me what it handled and what you checked yourself. If you handled it manually, tell me one step you’d simplify.



What to expect after you apply



We’re looking to hire within the next two to four weeks. If I’d like to meet you, I’ll reach out within a few days of receiving your application to schedule a 20- to 30-minute video interview. We’ll talk through a typical morning here, and you’ll have time to ask me questions, too.



If you’re selected for the role, I’ll send you a written offer within two days of your interview. Once you accept, we’ll agree on a start date for your paid onboarding.



Thanks for taking the time to apply. I look forward to hearing from you!



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO | Boulder Pro Painters

On call work is available if you want it. You are paid for being on call, and paid by the hour for any time you spend working on a call.





HOW TO APPLY



Send us a short video, 2 to 3 minutes long, in English. Please record it with the same webcam and headset you would use for work, because we want to see and hear your setup.



In the video, please:



1. Introduce yourself

2. Tell us about your IT experience, especially anything that matches what we do (Microsoft 365, Active Directory, networking, servers, security, VoIP)

3. Tell us why you think you are a good fit for this role

4. Tell us why you want to work with Meteor Networks

5. Confirm that you can work full time, Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Toronto time, and tell us if you are interested in on call work

6. Talk us through how you would handle the two scenarios below, as if you were explaining it to us on the phone



SCENARIO 1:

A new employee starts on Monday. Walk us through setting up their Microsoft 365 account, including the licence,
 and MFA, and adding them to the right groups so they can get to the shared files. Then tell us what you would check if they still cannot sign in.



SCENARIO 2:

Huntress flags a Microsoft 365 sign in for one of our users from another country, and the user approved the MFA prompt. You also find a new inbox rule that forwards their
 outside the company. Tell us how you would contain it, clean it up, and stop it from happening again.



Put "Meteor Tech Ready" in your subject line so we know you read the full post. Applications without a video or the subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Appointment Setter: Home Services (Morning Shift, Bonus-Heavy)
description:
Part-Time Appointment Setter: Home Services (Morning Shift, Bonus-Heavy, Growth Role)



Top performers earn $1,200-1,500+ USD/month.



About Us

J&B Quality Painters is a growing residential painting company in Edmonton, Canada. We do interior and exterior painting, cabinet refinishing and popcorn ceiling removal. We generate a steady flow of leads from homeowners who want work done. We need a fast, sharp setter who calls them right away, finds out what they need, and books qualified estimate appointments.



Our Core Values

Speed is king. A lead called in 5 minutes books; a lead called in an hour has already hired someone else.

Own the outcome. Your job isn't just dialing. It's a real appointment with a real homeowner who shows up.

Competitive greatness. You'll see your numbers every week, and you'll be paid for winning.



Your Mission

Turn every lead into a booked, qualified estimate appointment, as fast as possible.



What Good Looks Like



1. Speed to lead

Every new lead gets an automated text the moment it comes in.

You call every lead within 5 minutes during working hours, for both inbound and outbound leads.

Good looks like: 90% or more of leads called within 5 minutes.



2. Qualify every lead

Find out exactly what the homeowner wants done (rooms, exterior, cabinets, ceilings) and their timeline.

Confirm the project is worth $1,000 or more.

Confirm the address is in our Edmonton-area service zone and that the decision-maker will be there for the estimate.

Good looks like: every appointment you book is a real, qualified project.



3. Book and confirm the appointment

Book the estimate in our calendar (GoHighLevel).

Confirm it with the homeowner the day before so they show up.

Follow up with leads who didn't book, and with past leads, using our outbound scripts.

Good looks like: a high show rate, with appointments that turn into signed jobs.



Pay

Base: $500 USD per month, paid biweekly ($250 every second Friday).

Speed bonus: $50 per month when you call 90% or more of leads within 5 minutes.

Appointment bonus: $20 for every qualified appointment you book that actually happens (the estimate is completed with the homeowner).

Job bonus: an extra $25 when that appointment becomes a signed job.

Bonuses count only for appointments you personally book. They're paid monthly.

No bonus for appointments under $1,000, no-shows, or leads with false information.



Top performers earn $1,200-1,500+ USD/month. There's no cap on bonuses.



Schedule

We need someone who can work the morning shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM-1:00 PM Edmonton time. 30 hours a week.



Growth

This role starts part-time. Setters who consistently hit their numbers can grow into more hours, more lead sources, and a senior setter role.



You're a Fit If You:

Speak clear, confident, natural English on the phone.

Have experience in appointment setting, inside sales or calling for a home services company (roofing, HVAC, solar, painting, renovation).

Are comfortable calling strangers fast and asking direct questions.

Track your own numbers and like being paid for results.

Have experience with GoHighLevel. (A plus, not required.)



How to Apply

Start your application with the phrase "Five minutes or less" so we know you read the whole post.

Include a link to a 60-second voice recording (for example, Vocaroo). In it, pretend a homeowner just asked for a painting quote, and show us how you'd open the call.

In 2-3 sentences, tell us your best appointment-setting result and the numbers behind it.

title: Digital Media Buyer & Paid Advertising Specialist
description:
About the Position

First Direct is seeking an experienced Digital Media Buyer & Paid Advertising Specialist to manage paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and programmatic advertising platforms, including Viant.

This is a hands-on campaign execution and optimization position.

We are looking for someone who knows how to work directly inside advertising platforms to build, launch, monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize campaigns.



The ideal candidate has experience managing multiple client advertising accounts, understands how to analyze campaign performance, and proactively makes adjustments to improve results.

We need someone who takes ownership of advertising campaigns from initial setup through completion, ensuring they launch accurately, run consistently, stay within budget, and achieve client objectives.



Primary Responsibilities

Campaign Setup, Launch & Execution

• Build and launch campaigns in Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and Viant or comparable programmatic DSPs.

• Manage Google Search, Display, YouTube,
, Instagram, Connected TV (CTV), OTT, programmatic display, and retargeting campaigns.

• Configure geographic targeting, audience segments, budgets, bidding strategies, placements, campaign schedules, and frequency controls where applicable.

• Upload and verify advertising creatives, including display banners, video advertisements, and social media advertisements.

• Verify campaign settings, destination URLs, conversion tracking, and advertising pixels before launch.

• Ensure all campaigns follow approved client work orders, budgets, and promotional timelines.



Daily Campaign Monitoring & Troubleshooting

• Monitor active advertising campaigns daily across all assigned platforms.

• Verify that campaigns are actively delivering impressions and spending according to approved budgets.

• Identify campaigns with delivery issues, rejected advertisements, incorrect targeting, tracking problems, or unexpected spending.

• Monitor budget pacing to prevent overspending or significant underdelivery.

• Troubleshoot advertising issues and implement appropriate corrections.

• Identify performance changes and take proactive action rather than waiting for direction.

• Escalate significant campaign issues promptly and document corrective actions.



Campaign Optimization

• Evaluate campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve results.

• Adjust targeting, bids, budgets, placements, keywords, audiences, and creatives based on performance.

• Analyze CTR, CPC, CPM, reach, frequency, conversions, CPA, and ROAS where applicable.

• Optimize Google Search campaigns using search terms, negative keywords, bidding strategies, and conversion data.

• Optimize Meta campaigns through audience analysis, creative testing, placement performance, and conversion results.

• Optimize Viant and programmatic campaigns using delivery metrics, audience performance, geographic targeting, frequency, and inventory performance.

• Conduct A/B testing and recommend improvements based on campaign data.



Tracking, Analytics & Reporting

• Verify advertising pixels, conversion events, and tracking configurations.

• Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, and applicable programmatic tracking tools.

• Monitor campaign performance and identify discrepancies between advertising platforms and reporting tools.

• Prepare accurate performance reports and summarize results.

• Provide actionable recommendations based on campaign data.

• Maintain documentation of campaign changes, issues, and optimization activities.



Multi-Client Account & Budget Management

• Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.

• Maintain accurate records of campaign budgets, schedules, targeting, and status.

• Track daily and monthly advertising spend.

• Ensure campaigns launch and end on their approved dates.

• Coordinate with internal creative, web, and client services teams.

• Follow campaign setup, inspection, approval, and quality assurance procedures.



Required Qualifications

• Minimum 2 years of direct, hands-on paid advertising experience.

• Demonstrated proficiency with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

• Hands-on experience with Viant, The Trade Desk, or a comparable programmatic DSP.

• Experience managing display, video, search, social, and programmatic advertising campaigns.

• Understanding of CTV/OTT campaign delivery and performance measurement.

• Strong knowledge of campaign targeting, bidding, budgeting, pacing, and optimization.

• Experience with Google Analytics 4, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking.

• Ability to troubleshoot advertising delivery and performance issues independently.

• Experience managing multiple advertising accounts and budgets.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

• Exceptional attention to detail and accountability.



Preferred Qualifications

• Direct experience with the Viant advertising platform.

• Google Ads certifications.

• Experience managing advertising for local businesses and multi-location clients.

• Experience with Looker Studio, GoHighLevel, and Google Tag Manager.

• Previous marketing agency experience.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Digital Media Buyer at First Direct:

• Launches campaigns correctly and on schedule.

• Ensures all assigned campaigns are monitored daily.

• Identifies and resolves advertising delivery issues quickly.

• Keeps campaign spending within approved budgets.

• Makes proactive, data-driven optimization decisions.

• Maintains accurate reporting and campaign documentation.

• Manages multiple advertising accounts without missing deadlines or important details.

• Takes full ownership of campaign execution, monitoring, and performance.



About First Direct

First Direct is a fast-growing marketing agency based in Bellevue, Nebraska. We help businesses find the right marketing solutions to empower their growth and success.

Our six core values are Discipline, Inspirational, Accountability, Transparency, Alignment, and Results.

We invest in our employees' personal and professional development and provide opportunities for continued learning and growth.



Work Requirements

• Full-time, permanent position.

• Ability to work 8:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Central Time.

• Reliable computer and high-speed internet connection.

• Ability to work independently and collaborate with an international team.



Benefits

• 13th-month benefit.

• Performance bonus eligibility after 90 days.

• Forex fees benefit.



Application Instructions

Applying through OnlineJobs is only the first step in our interview process. Candidates must complete an application through our Careers page and all required assessments.

title: AI Video Ad Editor – Higgsfield (Genjutsu) + ElevenLabs | Health Supplement Brand
description:

HOURS: [30–40] hours/week



ABOUT US

CORVIA is a fast-growing US heart-health supplement brand building toward a

9-figure business. We run a high volume of video ads on
 and Instagram,

and we're building a team of AI video editors to create and test new ads every week.



HOW IT WORKS

Our founder films the raw ad footage: the acting, the script, the movement.

Your job is to transform that footage into finished ads. Using Higgsfield

Genjutsu, you'll replace the founder with new characters (different ages,

looks, and settings) while keeping the original motion and performance.

Then you edit everything into a polished, ready-to-run ad.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take our raw footage and use Higgsfield Genjutsu (motion transfer,

  character/object swaps, scene and style changes) to replace the person

  on screen with new characters

- Turn one recording into multiple versions of the same ad

  (different characters, settings, hooks)

- Add voiceovers with ElevenLabs so each character sounds natural and

  matches who's on screen, not robotic

- Finish every ad: cuts, captions, music, sound, pacing, vertical 9:16 format

- Fix AI glitches (faces, hands, lip sync, flicker) so the final ad looks real

- Follow creative briefs and turn around revisions quickly

- Keep files organized and named using our naming system



REQUIREMENTS

- Hands-on experience with Higgsfield (Genjutsu experience strongly preferred)

- Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice tools

- Solid editing skills in CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar

- A sharp eye for AI artifacts and the patience to clean them up

- Understand what makes a short-form ad work: a strong hook in the first

  3 seconds, fast pacing, clear message

- Good written English and reliable communication

- Stable internet and able to work independently

- Bonus: experience making ads for supplements, health, or ecommerce brands



IMPORTANT

Health ads have strict rules. You'll use only our approved claims and scripts.

No made-up medical claims, no fake doctors, and no cloning anyone's voice

without permission. We'll give you the guidelines.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any step will not be reviewed)

1. Record a short Loom video (2–3 min) introducing yourself and showing

   a Genjutsu character swap you've done (before and after)

2. Send links to your 3 best AI video ads

3. Start your application with the words "HEART LONGEVITY" so we know

   you read this post

title: Remote Sales Closer (SaaS)
description:
Job Overview



Riovis is looking for a confident, results-driven Sales Closer to join our growing sales team.



Riovis provides marketing software designed to help e-commerce businesses and direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands manage and execute their marketing activities more efficiently.



You will be responsible for conducting product demonstrations, speaking with business owners and marketing decision-makers, understanding their requirements, presenting Riovis' capabilities and converting qualified prospects into paying customers.



You will work closely with our Appointment Setter, who will identify prospects, initiate conversations and schedule qualified demonstrations for you.



This is a full-time sales position for someone who understands consultative selling, can confidently demonstrate software products and knows how to turn interested prospects into paying customers.



Responsibilities

- Conduct scheduled product demonstrations with qualified business prospects.

- Understand each prospect's business, marketing operations and requirements.

- Present Riovis' features and capabilities in a clear, engaging and relevant manner.

- Explain how Riovis can help businesses improve their marketing workflows.

- Identify customer needs and demonstrate relevant product solutions.

- Handle objections and answer questions confidently.

- Communicate the value of Riovis and its subscription plans.

- Convert product demonstrations into free-trial registrations and paying subscriptions.

- Follow up consistently with prospects who require additional information or time to make a decision.

- Guide prospects through the signup and onboarding process when necessary.

- Maintain accurate sales records and update the CRM.

- Work closely with the Appointment Setter to improve lead quality and conversion rates.

- Report on demonstrations, trial activations, conversions and lost opportunities.

- Provide feedback on recurring objections, customer requirements and opportunities to improve the sales process.



Requirements

- Proven experience in B2B sales, SaaS sales or software sales.

- Demonstrated ability to close sales through online meetings and product demonstrations.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

- Confidence speaking directly with business owners, founders and marketing decision-makers.

- Ability to understand customer requirements and present appropriate solutions.

- Experience handling objections and following up with prospects.

- Comfortable using CRM systems, video conferencing and online sales tools.

- Self-motivated, organized and results-oriented.

- Reliable internet connection, computer and professional working environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience selling SaaS subscriptions.

- Experience selling marketing software or digital services.

- Understanding of e-commerce and direct-to-consumer businesses.

- Familiarity with social media marketing and digital advertising.

- Experience conducting remote software demonstrations.

- Ability to manage a sales pipeline independently.



Compensation

Monthly Base Salary: $1,200–$1,500 USD

In addition to the monthly base salary, you will receive:

30% one-time commission on the first subscription payment received from each new customer you personally close.



There is no artificial cap on the number of customers you can close or the commissions you can earn.



Performance Expectations

The initial company-wide objective is to acquire 100 paying Riovis customers within 90 days.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Conducting approximately 3–5 product demonstrations per working day, depending on appointment availability.

- Following up with prospects consistently.

- Maintaining accurate CRM records.

- Converting qualified demonstrations into trial activations and paying customers.

- Helping prospects understand the product and complete their subscription.

- Working with the Appointment Setter to improve the overall sales funnel.



Performance will be evaluated based on sales conversion, customer acquisition, follow-up discipline and overall contribution to revenue.



Working Arrangement

- Full-time remote position.

- Daily coordination with the Appointment Setter.

- Regular sales performance reviews.

- CRM-based pipeline management.

- Scheduled online product demonstrations.

Working hours will be coordinated to accommodate US business hours.



How to Apply

Please include the following in your application:

1. A brief introduction about yourself and your sales experience.

2. Your experience selling SaaS products or other B2B services.

3. Examples of products or services you have successfully sold.

4. Your experience conducting online demonstrations and closing sales.

5. Your preferred working hours and availability.

6. A short explanation of how you approach closing a prospect who is interested but hesitant to purchase.



Please include the phrase "I CAN CLOSE" at the beginning of your application so we know you have read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of the sales process, build trust with prospects and consistently convert qualified opportunities into paying customers.
