title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Company: Veterans Educating Veterans

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Schedule: 40 hours per week



Position Summary

Veterans Educating Veterans is seeking an experienced and highly trustworthy Finance Manager to oversee the company’s financial operations.

This role will also be responsible for maintaining the financial records of a separate affiliated trust entity. The Finance Manager must keep both entities’ books, bank accounts, transactions, reports, and supporting documentation accurate, complete, and properly separated.

The ideal candidate is organized, analytical, proactive, and capable of independently managing financial reporting, budgeting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll coordination, reconciliations, collections, cash flow, and internal controls.



Key Responsibilities



1. Financial Management and Reporting

Prepare accurate weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

Monitor revenue, operating expenses, profitability, cash flow, and overall financial performance.

Develop and maintain budgets, financial forecasts, and budget-versus-actual reports.

Identify financial discrepancies, potential risks, unnecessary expenditures, and cost-saving opportunities.

Provide timely financial updates, analyses, and actionable recommendations to the CEO.

Ensure financial transactions are properly recorded, categorized, and supported by documentation.



2. Accounts Receivable and Collections

Oversee client invoicing, payment arrangements, recurring payments, and collection activities.

Monitor outstanding balances, overdue accounts, failed payments, chargebacks, refunds, and payment disputes.

Reconcile client payments across banking platforms, payment processors, accounting systems, and internal records.

Maintain accurate accounts receivable aging reports and collection records.

Identify collection issues and recommend strategies to improve payment recovery and cash flow.



3. Accounts Payable and Expense Management

Review and process vendor invoices, reimbursements, subscriptions, and operational expenses.

Verify that all payments are accurate, properly documented, and approved by authorized personnel.

Implement safeguards against duplicate, incorrect, or unauthorized payments.

Reconcile vendor statements, bank accounts, credit cards, and payment platforms.

Monitor recurring expenses and identify opportunities for operational cost reductions.



4. Payroll and Contractor Payment Coordination

Coordinate the timely and accurate processing of payroll and independent contractor payments.

Verify compensation rates, hours worked, bonuses, deductions, reimbursements, and payroll adjustments.

Collaborate with Human Resources regarding onboarding, terminations, leave records, compensation changes, and final payments.

Maintain accurate, organized, and confidential payroll and contractor payment records.

Investigate and resolve payroll discrepancies in coordination with authorized personnel.



5. Trust Entity Financial Management

Maintain complete and separate accounting records for the affiliated trust entity.

Accurately record and categorize trust income, expenditures, contributions, transfers, assets, and distributions.

Reconcile trust-related bank accounts, investment accounts, and applicable payment platforms.

Prepare independent financial statements and financial reports for the trust entity.

Maintain organized records relating to trustees, beneficiaries, vendors, assets, and distributions, as applicable.

Verify that trust-related transactions are properly authorized and consistent with applicable trust documents and requirements.

Coordinate with authorized trustees, accountants, tax professionals, attorneys, financial institutions, and other relevant parties.

Organize financial documentation required for tax preparation, audits, legal reviews, and trust accounting.

Immediately escalate suspicious transactions, missing documentation, unauthorized activities, or potential misuse of funds.



6. Financial Controls and Entity Separation

Maintain strictly separate financial records, accounts, reports, and documentation for VEV and the affiliated trust entity.

Prevent improper commingling of funds or unauthorized transfers between entities.

Ensure that expenses and payments are processed through the appropriate entity accounts.

Properly record and document all authorized inter-entity transactions.

Obtain written approval from designated authorities before processing transfers, refunds, distributions, or exceptional payments.

Maintain complete and traceable audit trails for material financial transactions.

Protect confidential company, client, employee, contractor, trustee, and beneficiary information.



7. Financial Systems and Process Improvement

Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records using Zoho Books and other approved accounting systems.

Evaluate and improve financial reporting, reconciliation, payment approval, and recordkeeping procedures.

Develop, document, and maintain finance-related Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

Identify opportunities for automation and operational efficiency without compromising internal controls.

Provide financial process guidance and training to relevant team members.

Ensure consistency, accuracy, and accountability across financial workflows.



8. Leadership and Cross-Department Coordination

Supervise finance and bookkeeping personnel, when applicable.

Delegate responsibilities, review completed work, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.

Collaborate with Human Resources, Operations, Client Services, and executive leadership.

Communicate financial concerns proactively and present practical recommendations.

Support financial planning and other finance-related initiatives assigned by the CEO.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.

Minimum of five (5) years of professional experience in accounting, finance, or financial operations.

At least two (2) years of supervisory or financial management experience.

Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, cash-flow management, accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll coordination, and account reconciliation.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

Experience using Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero, or comparable accounting software.

Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate financial records for multiple entities while ensuring proper separation.

Excellent analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.

High standards of integrity, discretion, confidentiality, and professional accountability.

Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple responsibilities, and meet reporting deadlines.

Reliable internet connectivity and a suitable professional remote working environment.



Preferred Qualifications

- Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent professional qualification.

- Hands-on experience with Zoho Books, Zoho CRM, or Zoho Analytics.

- Previous experience managing financial operations for a U.S.-based company.

- Familiarity with trust accounting, affiliated organizations, or multi-entity financial management.

- Experience coordinating payroll and payments for international contractors or remote teams.

- Experience developing financial SOPs, strengthening internal controls, and improving accounting workflows.



Performance Expectations



The Finance Manager's performance will be evaluated based on:

- Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial reports.

- Consistent completion of account reconciliations.

- Accuracy and timely coordination of payroll and vendor payments.

- Effectiveness of accounts receivable management and collection efforts.

- Reliability of budgets, forecasts, and cash-flow monitoring.

- Proper separation and accounting of VEV and affiliated trust finances.

- Compliance with internal financial controls and approval procedures.

- Quality and organization of financial documentation.

- Proactive identification and resolution of financial discrepancies.

- Professional responsiveness, reliability, confidentiality, and adherence to deadlines.



Compensation and Employment Terms

This is a full-time, remote position with a fixed, non-negotiable salary.

The agreed compensation covers the complete scope of responsibilities associated with both Veterans Educating Veterans and its affiliated trust entity.



Applicants are expected to review and accept the stated compensation and responsibilities before proceeding with the recruitment process.



Confidentiality, Financial Authority, and Accountability

The Finance Manager will have access to highly sensitive financial information, including company banking records, payroll details, client payment information, trust records, and confidential trustee and beneficiary information.



Strict confidentiality and adherence to established financial controls are mandatory.



The Finance Manager is not authorized to independently:

- Transfer or distribute company or trust funds without appropriate approval.

- Process unauthorized payments or financial adjustments.

- Modify employee or contractor compensation without authorization.

- Open or close financial accounts.

- Make investment decisions on behalf of either entity.

- Disclose confidential financial or personal information to unauthorized individuals.



Suspected fraud, misuse of funds, unauthorized disclosures, or serious violations of established financial procedures will be investigated and may result in termination of the working relationship and legal action, where warranted and permitted by applicable law.



Equal Opportunity Statement



Veterans Educating Veterans is committed to providing equal opportunities to qualified applicants. Recruitment and selection decisions are based on relevant qualifications, professional experience, demonstrated competence, integrity, and organizational requirements, without unlawful discrimination.



Join Veterans Educating Veterans



We are looking for a dependable and results-driven Finance Manager who can take ownership of financial operations, maintain strong internal controls, and support the organization's continued growth through accurate reporting, financial discipline, and responsible management of resources.

title: Licensed Primary Teacher (Grades 1–2) – Live Online Mornings – ₱20,000/mo + allowances – Australian family
description:
LICENSED PRIMARY TEACHER (GRADES 1–2) – LIVE ONLINE SCHOOL MORNINGS FOR AN AUSTRALIAN FAMILY



₱20,000/month retainer for 15 hours a week (about ₱300/hour), paid 12 months a year for 40 teaching weeks, plus allowances, 13th month and a year-end bonus. Long-term, one family, fixed morning schedule. Start 25 January 2027.



ABOUT US

We are an Australian family of three – Dad (widower) and two boys aged 5 and 7 – living aboard a catamaran and sailing from Australia to Indonesia in 2027. The boys are of Australian and Filipino parentage and are enrolled in an Australian online school. We are looking for a licensed primary teacher to run their live school morning on Zoom every weekday for the whole of 2027.



THE ROLE

- Monday to Friday, three hours live on Zoom, in the boys' Australian time zone. In Philippine time that is 0730–1030 until early April 2027, then 0830–1130, then 0900–1200 from October 2027.

- ₱20,000 a month, paid 12 months a year for 40 teaching weeks (school holidays are paid).

- 13th month pay and a year-end bonus for reliability.

- Paid on the 1st of each month by bank transfer, wherever we are.

- Paid trial week (₱6,000) 18–22 January 2027 before the retainer starts.

- Five paid leave days a year plus Philippine public holidays on school days.

- One month's notice either way after the trial week.

Once we all know each other there is an option – by mutual agreement,  to join our family aboard full-time for part or all of the voyage. YOU

title: Professional Video Editors Wanted: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro
description:
COME EDIT VIDEOS THAT MAKE PEOPLE SMILE!



Ice Cream Sunshine is hiring a small team of Professional Video Editors for long-term, remote roles. If you love turning raw footage into warm, fun stories, and you edit by hand with software you own, we would love to meet you.



TO BE CONSIDERED, please send everything listed in the HOW TO APPLY section of this post.



Prefer a cleaner, easier-to-read version of this post? View the designed document here:


 



----------------------------------------

ABOUT ICE CREAM SUNSHINE

----------------------------------------



Ice Cream Sunshine is a good vibes signature ice cream tour and special events company based in Chicago. We lead delicious ice cream walking tours through Chicago's iconic neighborhoods, where guests learn fun facts about the city and enjoy treats along the way. We also host special events, and we share our love of ice cream through videos on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and
.



GOOD VIBES ONLY: We believe in respect, appreciation and fun. We do excellent work, we laugh a lot, and we celebrate birthdays. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously.



----------------------------------------

THE ROLE

----------------------------------------



You will join a friendly team of video editors. Our founder films the footage, and you turn it into polished, publish-ready videos that keep viewers watching. Our mix is longer YouTube videos plus short vertical videos for TikTok, Reels and Shorts.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Edit ice cream review videos with our founder's quirky, warm, fun on-camera energy

- Edit long-form and short-form videos, plus tour highlights and behind-the-scenes content

- Add captions, sound design, music and color that match our brand: natural pacing, clean captions, graphics used sparingly

- Share ideas that help viewers stay until the end

- Deliver on agreed deadlines and tell us early if anything changes



========================================

IMPORTANT: PLEASE READ THIS FIRST

========================================



We are flexible on many things, like your schedule within our core hours. These three things stay the same for everyone, so every editor's work is safe, legal and ethical.



1. ACTIVE, PAID LICENSES ONLY.

WE DO NOT SUPPORT OR ALLOW CRACKED OR PIRATED SOFTWARE.

You must hold your own active, paid license for every editing program you use, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, After Effects, Audition or Photoshop.



2. WE DO NOT USE CAPCUT.

Because of its data and privacy terms, CapCut is not used on any Ice Cream Sunshine project, and it does not count toward our software requirement.



3. MANUAL EDITING WITH RELIABLE, ETHICAL TOOLS.

Every cut is made manually. We highly prefer not using AI-assisted editing, auto-cut tools, or AI-written scripts, voiceovers, etc.



Still planning to buy your license? No problem. Please apply once it is active, we would love to hear from you then.



----------------------------------------

WHAT YOU BRING

----------------------------------------



MUST HAVE

- Professional skill in at least one of: Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro as your main editing tool

- An active, paid license for each editing program you use (see IMPORTANT above)

- Several years of paid, professional video editing experience with real clients, and a portfolio that shows it

- Strong spoken and written English

- Availability that overlaps 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Chicago time, Monday to Friday, plus our Tuesday team meeting. In the Philippines, this is about 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM until mid-March.



A BIG PLUS

- Adobe After Effects (keyframed animation with easing, masking and motion tracking), plus Adobe Audition and Photoshop

- Hooks and pacing for short-form, story structure for long-form

- J-cuts, L-cuts, match cuts, cutting on action, color correction and grading

- Experience with personality-led, food or lifestyle content

- A kind, proactive teammate who takes feedback well and communicates early



----------------------------------------

WHAT WE OFFER

----------------------------------------



- $6 to $8 per hour. 

- ROOM TO GROW: Based on performance and business needs: rate increases quarterly, or sooner for great performance and output, plus more hours or full-time work, and growth into a lead role.

- FLEXIBILITY: Part time to start, with hours that grow as our content grows.

- SUPPORT: Licensed music provided for you, and a team that answers your questions.

- GOOD VIBES: A respectful team, birthday celebrations, and virtual team fun.



----------------------------------------

HOW TO APPLY

----------------------------------------



SEND ALL FOUR ITEMS BELOW IN YOUR FIRST ONLINEJOBS.PH MESSAGE.

Please copy the format below, paste it into your message, and fill it in so we can see your work right away.



>>>>>>>>>> START OF YOUR MESSAGE >>>>>>>>>>



Hello Ice Cream Sunshine,



1. COVER LETTER (in your own words, no AI). Please cover:

(1) Your expertise in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, and After Effects if you use it.

(2) Your active, paid license for each tool you named. Licensed copies only, never cracked or pirated.

(3) Your background with past clients: who you edited for, and how you used these tools on those projects.



2. PORTFOLIO LINKS (real footage and manual edits only). Please include:

(1) Your portfolio website, Google Drive or similar page that shows your full, competitive body of work.

(2) 2 links to your best vertical short-form videos.

(3) 2 links to your best long-form horizontal videos.



3. RESUME LINK

Updated and easy to open, with your references and a full account of your past work experience.



4. INTRO VIDEO LINK

60 to 90 seconds, recorded for this application. Start with "Hello Ice Cream Sunshine," then tell us:

(1) Your favorite ice cream.

(2) What you love about being a video editor.

Simple and unscripted is perfect.



<<<<<<<<<<< END OF YOUR MESSAGE <<<<<<<<<<<



COMPLETE APPLICATIONS ONLY: We want to give every applicant the same fair look, so we can only consider applications that include all four items in the first message. We love reading each one, and we look forward to yours.



TIP: Make sure all your links open without a login (set sharing to "anyone with the link").



----------------------------------------

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

---------------------
. APPLICATION REVIEW: We review your cover letter, portfolio, resume and intro video.

2. SHORT SURVEY/APPLICATION FORM: Candidates who might be a fit receive a survey/form that takes about 15 minutes.

3. ROUND 1 INTERVIEW: A video call of about 60 to 90 minutes with a live manual editing demo. Choose stock footage or a past sample project, and edit it live, manually, from scratch to finished video while you walk us through your flow.

4. PAID TEST PROJECT: Selected candidates complete a short agreement and a paid test video.

5. FINAL MEETING AND OFFER: A conversation with our team and manager.



----------------------------------------



Essential qualities: you love to learn and you love to have fun.



Everyone at Ice Cream Sunshine wishes you joy always and delicious ice cream too. 🍦

title: Design & Administrative Virtual Assistant
description:
ABOUT US



Honeycomb Design Collective is a creative portfolio company based in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee, USA. We bring together interior design, architecture, engineering, marketing and brand, photo and video content, and custom fabrication under one roof. Our primary client is a luxury short-term rental company that manages dozens of high-end cabins, and we also have active new-build developments across the region.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a detail-obsessed virtual assistant to keep our design and operations engine running. You'll handle admin and inbox support, Canva design work, order tracking and receiving, and markups on supplier documents from our China manufacturers. You'll also be the day-to-day point of contact for our overseas team in Pakistan.



You'll report directly to our VP & Company Designer and work across dozens of luxury cabins and active new builds.



• Full-time, remote (Philippines-based contractor)

• Partial overlap with US Eastern time required

• The Philippines shares a time zone with our China suppliers and sits close to our Pakistan team, so this role is the bridge across all three



HOW WE SPLIT THE WORK



Every item, selection list, and project moves through three passes:



1. First ~20% (VP & Company Designer): sets direction, makes the selections, and places all orders.

2. Middle 60–70% (you): the build-out. This covers tracking, logging, markups, Canva layouts, supplier and overseas follow-up, and getting everything organized and checked.

3. Final pass (VP & Company Designer): reviews, adjusts, and approves before anything goes out or gets paid.



Your job is to take a clear starting point and hand back work that's 90% done and easy to approve.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



1. Admin & Executive Support

• Triage
, manage the calendar, schedule meetings and interviews, and send follow-ups

• Turn meeting notes into clean Google Docs with action items

• Log and reconcile card charges into our expense report across several business entities, with receipts attached and no duplicate entries

• Keep Google Drive organized: project folders by property and lot, supplier catalogs, selections, and final specs

• Update project trackers (design and construction status, owner deliverables, deadlines)



2. Canva & Design Support

• Build and edit Canva designs: design selection boards, mood boards, owner presentations, proposals, flyers, guest signage, welcome books, and social graphics

• Apply brand kits correctly across multiple brands and keep templates up to date

• Resize and export for print vs. digital, and prep print-ready files for vendors

• Format polished documents and decks from rough notes



3. Order Tracking & Receiving

• Track every order once it's placed (you won't place orders or make purchases): furniture, decor, lighting, hospitality supplies, and finishes

• Maintain a master order log with vendor, order/PO number, item, quantity, cost, ETA, and ship-to property or lot

• Follow up with vendors on confirmations, ship dates, and backorders

• Track shipments and freight, including overseas containers, and flag delays early

• Receiving: match deliveries to orders, log shortages and damage with photos, prep vendor claims and returns for approval, and notify the on-site team

• Keep a property-by-property furnishing status so we always know what's been ordered, what's arrived, and what's installed



4. China Supplier Markups & Coordination

• Mark up supplier quotes, proforma invoices, shop drawings, and spec sheets with corrections to dimensions, colors, finishes, and quantities

• Compare every supplier quote against our approved selections and flag discrepancies before anything is paid

• Maintain master quote workbooks with product images, organized by lot

• Communicate with suppliers on samples, production photos, lead times, and shipping documents (PI, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading)



5. Pakistan Team & Overseas Coordination

• Act as the daily point of contact for our Pakistan-based team: hand off tasks, clarify briefs, and quality-check returned work before it comes to us

• Track deadlines across overseas teams and chase anything that's late

• Send a short end-of-day summary: what's done, what's waiting, and what needs a decision

• Use the time-zone advantage to clear overnight questions so answers are ready by US morning



MUST-HAVE SKILLS



• Excellent written and spoken English

• Advanced Canva (brand kits, templates, resizing, print exports). Portfolio required.

• Strong Google Workspace: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets (filters, lookups, basic formulas)

• Confident with PDF and image markup tools (any tool you prefer, including free or low-cost options) and comfortable reading drawings and spec sheets

• Order-tracking experience (purchase orders, shipment tracking, receiving)

• Highly organized, proactive, and precise with numbers, quantities, and dimensions

• Reliable high-speed internet, a backup connection, and backup power



NICE TO HAVE



• Background in interior design, furniture, construction, real estate, or hospitality/vacation rentals

• Experience working with Chinese manufacturers or Alibaba suppliers, and with import paperwork

• Experience managing or coordinating offshore teams

• Familiarity with WhatsApp/WeChat for business, Slack, Buildertrend, Hospitable, or AI tools like Claude



YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



Days 1–30: Own inbox triage, calendar, expense logging, and Drive organization. Produce your first Canva selection boards from templates.



Days 31–60: Run the master order log and receiving process end to end. Take over daily Pakistan team handoffs.



Days 61–90: Independently mark up China supplier quotes and drawings, catch discrepancies before approval, and deliver a weekly status summary without being asked.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:

1. Your resume

2. A link to your Canva portfolio

3. A short note about your order-tracking or overseas-coordination experience



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test task. You'll mark up a sample supplier quote PDF against a selection list and build one Canva selection board.

title: Client Acquisition Strategist
description:
ABOUT US





Kings of Content is a faith-based, short-form video production and content agency. We help business owners, creators, and entrepreneurs grow with story-driven content, and we are building a majority AI-powered business where AI does the heavy lifting and our team steers the ship.





We have leads coming in. What we do not have is a real system for nurturing those leads and closing them, and we are honest enough to say that out loud. That is exactly why this role exists.





ABOUT THE ROLE





We are looking for an experienced client acquisition and lead nurture strategist. Not someone we have to train, and not someone waiting to be told what to do. We want someone who has done this for other companies, got real results, and can walk into our business, look at what we have, and tell us what to do.





You will lead strategy on lead nurture and client acquisition end to end. Assume we have no good process right now, because we do not. You will be building it.





Your work will include:





Auditing our current leads, pipeline, and follow-up, and telling us honestly what is broken and what is missing





Building and running a lead nurture system from scratch: follow-up sequences, reactivation of old leads, and a clear path from first touch to booked call to closed client





Leading the closing side: improving our sales calls, our offers, and our follow-up so more of the right leads become paying clients





Guiding our lead magnet strategy: we can build lead magnets, and we need someone who knows which ones to build, how to position them, and how to use them to attract the right clients





Getting more hooks in the water: advising us on every practical way to attract clients, not just one channel





Running organic client acquisition through social media. You will have full access to our social media accounts to start conversations, nurture relationships, and turn attention into booked calls





Bringing proven frameworks with you. We heavily look up to Alex Hormozi and his strategies because of how simple and effective they are. If you know his work, or you have run similar systems at other companies and can bring what worked there into ours, that is a major plus





Reporting clearly on what is working, what is not, and what you recommend we do next. We want your judgment, not just your hours





PAY





Base pay rate plus commissions based on each client you help us close. The better you perform, the more you earn. Tell us in your application what base rate you are looking for and how you would like the commission structured.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR





Real, proven experience in lead nurture, lead generation, and closing for other companies, with results you can point to. This is the heart of the role and we will ask about it in detail





Experience building a nurture or acquisition system from scratch, not just running someone else's playbook





Familiarity with Alex Hormozi's approach to lead generation and offers (for example $100M Leads and $100M Offers), or an equally simple, proven framework you have actually used





Experience creating or directing lead magnets that produced real leads





Experience acquiring clients organically through social media: content, comments, direct messages, and relationship building





Comfort with CRMs and follow-up tools. We use GoHighLevel, so experience there is a plus





You diagnose problems and propose your own solutions. You are the expert in the room on this topic, and we will treat you that way





You communicate clearly, reply quickly, and take ownership of your numbers





WHAT TO INCLUDE IN YOUR APPLICATION





At least one real example of a lead nurture or client acquisition system you built or ran for another company: what you did, and what results it produced in numbers





The framework or strategy you would bring to a company like ours, in your own words





Your desired base hourly rate, and the commission structure you would propose





APPLICATION QUESTIONS (PLEASE ANSWER ALL OF THEM)





1. Tell us about your experience with lead nurture and client acquisition for other companies. Which companies or industries, what was your role, and what results did you produce?



2. Walk us through one lead nurture or acquisition system you built from scratch. What did it include, and what did it accomplish in numbers?



3. How familiar are you with Alex Hormozi's strategies ($100M Leads, $100M Offers, the Core Four)? Have you ever run a system based on his approach, and what happened?



4. If you started with us tomorrow and we told you, "we have leads but no real nurture process," what would your first 30 days look like? Be specific.



5. What lead magnets have you created or directed before? What were they, who were they for, and how did they perform?



6. How have you acquired clients organically through social media before? Tell us about the accounts, the approach, and the results.



7. What is your experience with sales calls and closing? How many calls have you taken or overseen, and what close rate did you see?



8. Which CRMs and tools have you used for lead nurture and follow-up (for example GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Close, or others)? How did you use them?



9. What would you do with full access to our founder's social media accounts to bring in clients organically? Give us your honest plan, not a generic one.



10. On a scale of 1 to 10, how would you rate your spoken English?



11. Can you reply to messages within a 12-hour window, Monday through Friday?



12. Do you have a faith? Please tell us a little bit about it.



13. How does your faith shape the way you work?



14. What is your perspective on Jesus Christ, and how do you view Him?





HOW TO APPLY





To be considered, you MUST
 your application to 
 using this EXACT subject line. Copy and paste it:





Client Acquisition Strategist For Kings of Content :)





In the body of your
, copy and paste the questions above and answer ALL of them, and include everything listed under "What to include in your application."





Applications that do not use the exact subject line, or that are missing answers, will not be reviewed. We are excited to meet you!

title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Google Ads, Meta Ads & TikTok Ads)
description:
About us



We are a growing US-based company in the beauty industry. Our hair care brand has multiple locations in Maryland, franchise locations in other states, a new location opening soon, and an online store for hair extensions and hair care products. We also run a second local service business with walk-in customers and pickup and delivery. Both businesses depend on local customers who come back again and again.



The role



We need one hands-on specialist to run paid advertising for both brands: Google Ads, Meta Ads 
 and Instagram) and TikTok Ads. You will own campaign setup, tracking, optimization and weekly reporting, and work with our team, who provide photos, videos and promotions.



Most of all, we want someone with initiative. You will learn how our businesses work, notice what could be better, and bring us ideas without waiting to be asked. We value a specialist who thinks like a business owner, not just someone who follows instructions.



This is not a social media posting or general VA role. You must have personally run paid campaigns for beauty businesses and be able to show results.



What you will do



- Build, manage and optimize Google Search campaigns, including keyword research, negative keywords, bids and budgets.

- Set up and fix conversion tracking with Google Ads, GA4 and Google Tag Manager, plus the Meta Pixel and TikTok Pixel.

- Run Meta Ads campaigns for local customers, including retargeting and audience and creative tests.

- Launch and manage TikTok Ads campaigns and find the formats that work.

- Find ways to turn first-time customers into loyal, repeat customers, and to win back customers who have not returned.

- Suggest new campaign ideas, offers and tests each month based on what you see in the data.

- Track CPC, CTR, conversion rate, CPA and ROAS, and move budget toward what works.

- Keep budgets, campaigns and reports clearly separated for each brand.

- Send a short weekly report for each brand: spend, results, cost per result, and your recommendations.

- Review landing pages, booking pages and the online store, and recommend fixes.

- Monitor Google Search Console and Google Business Profile for each location and suggest basic SEO improvements.

- Write ad copy and tell our team which images and videos you need.



Required



- 2+ years of hands-on paid ads experience, managing campaigns yourself.

- Proven experience running paid ads for beauty businesses, such as hair salons, spas, beauty products or hair extensions.

- Proven Google Ads Search experience with real budgets.

- Proven Meta Ads Manager experience, including retargeting.

- Working knowledge of GA4 and Google Tag Manager for conversion tracking.

- A track record of bringing your own ideas to improve results, not only running what you are told.

- Comfortable reading performance data and explaining it in plain English.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Able to work independently and manage more than one brand at once.



Preferred



- TikTok Ads experience, especially for beauty brands.

- Experience with businesses that have multiple locations or franchise locations.

- Experience with local businesses that run on appointment bookings or recurring customers.

- Experience with Shopify or e-commerce ads for beauty or hair products.

- Experience with salon booking software, GoHighLevel or similar marketing tools.

- Spanish (helpful, not required).

- Looker Studio or simple automated reporting.



Schedule



Full-time, 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM US Eastern Time, including a 1-hour break. Please check the time difference from your location before applying.



Engagement

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (Permanent WFH)
description:
Job Description

The Centralized Services Engineer II (Sr. IT Infrastructure Engineer) plays a pivotal role within ITS by ensuring seamless operation, optimization, and advancement of both internal and client-facing IT environments. This position requires a highly skilled professional with expertise in infrastructure architecture, cloud systems, MSP tools, and automation. The Engineer II owns the architecture and standards for Centralized Services (CS), serves as the final escalation point within the CS team, and drives innovation through scripting, automation, and tool integrations. This role is responsible for Veeam backup architecture, deployment standards, and complex recovery escalation, and mentors Engineer I, Administrator, and Technician staff. 



Job Responsibilities 

Escalation and Support 

• Serve as the final escalation point within CS for complex issues unresolved by Engineer I staff and the internal helpdesk. 

• Lead complex or high-impact backup recoveries, ensuring critical data recovery and system integrity. 

Onboarding and Offboarding 

• Own internal user and client onboarding and offboarding processes, setting standards and continuously improving them. 

• Lead complex client onboardings and offboardings, ensuring all systems, accounts, and configurations are properly set up or decommissioned. 

Infrastructure Architecture 

• Design and architect datacenter and cloud infrastructure, focusing on Windows and Azure environments. 

• Define infrastructure standards and review builds and changes implemented by Engineer I staff. 

Backup Architecture 

• Design Veeam backup architecture and deployment standards for internal and client environments. 

• Define backup policies, retention, and verification standards for efficiency, compliance, and security. 

• Review backup failure trends across all environments and drive structural fixes. 

RMM (Remote Monitoring and Management) 

• Own the ConnectWise Automate platform configuration and standards. 

• Set the RMM automation strategy and review scripts and workflows developed by the team. 

MDM (Mobile Device Management) 

• Own Addigy and Intune platform configuration and standards. 

• Set the MDM automation strategy and review scripts developed by the team. 

PSA (Professional Services Automation) 

• Own ConnectWise Manage configuration and the design of service delivery workflows. 

• Tool Integration and Management 

• Lead proof-of-concept evaluations for new MSP tools and recommend adoption. 

• Design and implement integrations between tools within the MSP environment. 

Patching Management 

• Architect Windows and third-party patching processes and define compliance and security standards. 

Leadership and Mentoring 

• Mentor Engineer I, Administrator, and Technician staff, and review their technical work. 

• Lead CS projects and make architecture decisions in line with ITS strategy. 

• Documentation 

• Create and maintain architecture and design documentation for infrastructure, tools, and processes. 

• Set documentation standards for Veeam configurations, verification processes, and remediation procedures, and review documentation produced by the team. 



Job Qualifications 

Education and Experience 

• Microsoft associate-level or higher certifications (e.g., AZ-104, AZ-800/801, AZ-305) 

• Veeam certification (VMCE) preferred 

• Networking certifications advantageous 

• 5+ years of experience in an MSP environment, including at least 2 years in an engineering role 

Technical Skills 

• Expertise in Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, and cloud technologies. 

• Proficiency with RMM tools (ConnectWise Automate) and PSA platforms (ConnectWise Manage). 

• Strong scripting skills in PowerShell or similar languages. 

• Experience with MDM platforms (Addigy, Intune). 

• Familiarity with MSP tools and their integrations. 

• Experience with database platforms (MSSQL, MySQL). 

• Adept at networking (Cisco, HPE, Dell, SonicWall, FortiGate). 

• Strong understanding of backup infrastructure architecture, deployment, and verification using Veeam. 

• Proven experience designing infrastructure, backup, and automation solutions across multiple client environments. 

Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. 

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

• Detail-oriented with a focus on process improvement. 

• Skilled in documentation. 

• Ability to mentor and develop junior staff. 

• Sound independent judgment on architecture and escalation decisions. 



Job Requirements

• A home office set up that meets the following:

o Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following:

 Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or

 AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or

 macOS 12 or newer.

o Internet: Stable internet connection with at least 25 Mbps download and upload speeds.

o Audio Equipment: A quality headset with a noise-cancellation feature for meetings.

o Mobile Device: A smartphone capable of installing the Microsoft Authenticator app.

o Webcam: An HD webcam for video calls.

o 2nd Monitor

• A very strong cultural fit the ITS way (Our core values will be discussed during the interview)

Compensation

Benefits

Full-Time

title: Senior Video Editor
description:
SENIOR VIDEO EDITOR — ECOMMERCE META ADS

Remote | Full-time | $900–$1,500 USD depending on experience



ABOUT MHI MEDIA



MHI Media is a performance marketing agency helping ambitious e-commerce and DTC brands grow. We create and test the ads that drive sales for brands operating at serious scale.



Our creative team is made up of editors, designers, strategists and pod leads working together across a large portfolio of brands. We produce a high volume of creative, learn from performance data and improve quickly — so this is a great environment for someone who wants to become genuinely excellent at advertising, not just make videos that look nice.



THE ROLE



We are looking for a high-quality Video Editor who understands that a paid social ad has one job: earn attention, communicate the idea clearly and move the viewer towards action.



You will edit e-commerce video ads for Meta from briefs, scripts, references and raw assets. You will work closely with creative strategists and pod leads, submit work for internal QA, respond to feedback and keep improving your output over time.



This role is not for someone who needs to be chased through every step. We want an editor who can understand a brief, make strong creative decisions, check their own work and deliver reliably.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



- Edit e-commerce video ads for Meta, generally using UGC, product footage, stock, screen recordings, founder content, AI-generated assets and b-roll

- Build strong opening hooks and produce thoughtful variations from winning creative

- Create clear, well-paced edits with effective captions, text overlays, sound design, music and light motion graphics

- Follow the brief and reference closely while adapting the edit to the product, audience and brand

- Make sure visuals, voiceover, captions, claims, offers, product details and brand assets all match the brief

- Submit organised work through our production workflow and meet agreed deadlines

- Apply QA feedback accurately rather than repeating the same mistakes

- Repurpose winning concepts into new hooks, edits, lengths, placements and aspect ratios

- Communicate early when a brief, asset or deadline is unclear or blocked

- Study performance feedback and use it to make future creative stronger



WHAT GREAT PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE



- Your first version is already clean, considered and close to the brief

- You understand why a hook, cut, pause, caption or visual is being used — not just how to add it

- You catch spelling, pacing, safe-zone, branding, continuity and audio issues before submitting

- You can take direct feedback without becoming defensive and implement it properly

- You are reliable: deadlines are met, blockers are raised early and tasks do not disappear

- Your work gets better as you learn what performs for different audiences and brands

- Strategists and pod leads trust you with increasingly important work



WHO WE WANT



We want operators, not talkers.



You will probably do well here if you are:



- Performance-minded: interested in what makes people stop, watch and buy

- Detail-obsessed: you notice the one typo, wrong product, weak cut or incorrect logo before anyone else does

- A strong brief reader: you follow direction precisely and ask questions when something is unclear

- Coachable: you actively want detailed feedback and use it to improve

- Proactive: you look for the next useful action instead of waiting to be chased

- Fast but not careless: you can work at volume without lowering your standards

- Commercially curious: you want to understand the customer, offer, audience and creative strategy behind the edit

- A clear communicator: you can explain your decisions and flag problems early

- Comfortable working remotely with a distributed team and shared deadlines



This probably will not be the right role for you if you only want to make cinematic edits, dislike performance-driven work, ignore briefs, take feedback personally or need constant supervision.



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of professional video editing experience

- A portfolio showing e-commerce, direct-response, paid social, UGC or comparable advertising work

- Strong skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut or a similar professional editing tool

- Working knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, music and basic colour correction

- Strong understanding of pacing, hooks, retention and vertical video formats

- Professional written and spoken English

- Reliable computer, internet connection and availability for full-time remote work

- Ability to work within a structured workflow and meet deadlines consistently



NICE TO HAVE



- Experience editing Meta ads for DTC or e-commerce brands

- Experience working from performance data or iterating ads based on results

- After Effects, Photoshop, Figma or graphic-design ability

- Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, ElevenLabs, Runway, Descript or similar

- Familiarity with Airtable, 
, Slack or comparable production tools

- Experience creating multiple hooks or variations from one core concept



WHAT WE OFFER



- Fully remote, long-term work with a growing international team

- Exposure to real e-commerce brands and creative that runs in live ad accounts

- The chance to see what actually performs, rather than editing in a results vacuum

- A clear path to grow into a senior editor, specialist editor or pod-lead position

title: Gaming Channel Manager and Editor
description:
MTR is a full time creator with a commentary channel of nearly one million subscribers and hundreds of millions of long form views. He just launched a new gaming channel and needs help from a manager / editor.



MTR creates the content. You run everything else.



This is not an assistant job. You will not get a checklist or daily direction. You get the raw streams, full access to the channel and every platform, and one job: grow it. You will be judged on results. Views, subscribers, watch time, and growth. That's it.

What you'll own



Livestream to long form

• Go through every livestream recording and pull the best moments.

• Cut and upload full videos to YouTube: highlights, compilations, best of, storylines.

• Own titles, thumbnails, descriptions, tags, and upload timing.



Short form across every platform

• Cut vertical clips from every stream.

• Post consistently to YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels,
, and X.

• Adapt captions, hooks, and formatting to each platform. No lazy cross posting.



Channel management

• Set and run the posting schedule.

• Track analytics weekly and double down on what works.

• Test formats, hooks, and thumbnails. Kill what doesn't perform.

• Manage comments and community where it helps growth.

• Spot trends in the gaming space and move on them fast.



How you'll work

• MTR drops markers during streams for moments he knows are good. Treat those as a starting point, not the full list. Find what he missed.

• Recordings and marker files land in a shared folder after each stream. You take it from there.

• No approvals needed to post. You have the keys.

• One short weekly report: what went out, what performed, what you're changing next week.



How you'll be measured

• Subscriber growth across channels

• Total views and watch time

• Short form reach and follower growth per platform

• Posting consistency

• Revenue growth as the channel monetizes

Specific targets get set together in the first 30 days. After that, the numbers do the talking.



Who you are

• You've grown a gaming or creator channel before and can show the numbers.

• You know what makes a clip hit in the first two seconds.

• You understand YouTube packaging: titles, thumbnails, retention.

• You know how each short form platform works and what each algorithm rewards.

• You play or follow GTA and gaming culture.

• Self starter. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap and fill it.

• Reliable. You post on schedule without reminders.



Nice to have

• Experience with AI clipping tools like OpusClip or Descript

• Thumbnail design skills

• Experience running multiple platforms for one creator



Not a fit if

• You need step by step direction.

• You want approval before every post.

• You can't point to results you've driven.



How to apply

Send:

1.  Links to channels or accounts you've grown, with before and after numbers

2.  Three to five clips or videos you edited that performed

3.  One paragraph on how you'd turn a four hour GTA stream into a week of content

 or similar AP tools
